description.en: A newborn Digital Monster. Dark peach fuzz bristles across the surface of its slimy body. This new addition to the Digital World can’t fight, but it can shoot bubbles from its mouth to intimidate foes.
description.zh: 剛出生沒多久的數碼寶貝。軟泥狀的身體表面長滿了黑色的胎毛。由於才剛出生而無法戰鬥，但可以從口中吐出泡沫般的東西威嚇敵人。

description.en: A small, blue Dragon Digimon child. Chibomon may be small and powerless, but it possesses the ability to Digivolve into any Dragon Digimon. This is why the Digimon is valued highly by Tamers and Dragon Digimon researchers alike. Chibomon is cherished for its friendly and curious nature, which are unique characteristics of In-Training Digimon. It spits Acid Bubbles to attack just like other In-Training Digimon, but they’re as devoid of power as one would expect.
description.zh: 體型嬌小，藍色的龍型數碼寶貝幼子。雖然體型小且力量薄弱，卻蘊含著能進化成各種龍型數碼寶貝的可能性。因此，芝高獸對龍型數碼寶貝研究者與馴獸師來說是相當珍貴的數碼寶貝。芝高獸因為幼年期數碼寶貝特有的親人個性與旺盛的好奇心而備受寵愛。與其他幼年期數碼寶貝相同，會吐出酸性泡沫來攻擊，不過毫無威力可言。

description.en: A super-small Machine Digimon with red eyes that act as photosensors. Choromon’s constant restless movements make it seem very cute, but these are just reactions to bright light brought on by simple programming, meaning it will cease functioning in dark places. Electricity will lance off of the tip of its tail when it is in a good mood, for reasons that are unknown. It uses its move Jamming Powder to emit metal particles and temporarily confuse its enemy’s AI. It then takes advantage of this temporary confusion to flee from the enemy.
description.zh: 超小型機械數碼寶貝，那對紅色眼珠是光線感應器。雖然不停來回移動的樣子十分惹人憐愛，不過由於只植入了簡單的程式，僅能配合明亮的光線來回移動，當周圍變暗便會停止動作。不知道為什麼，電鼠獸心情好的時候，會從尾巴放電。拿手的招式是釋放鐵粒子，短暫干擾敵人AI（人工智慧）的「干擾粉末」。電鼠獸會用這招讓敵人陷入混亂，趁機逃走。

description.en: A Digimon born wearing a leather hat. Though Cotsucomon may seem strong compared to other In-Training Digimon because of its armor, the soft leather doesn’t actually provide much protection. Highly cautious by nature, Cotsucomon is quick to draw back into its hat. Its special move is Knock, which involves poking foes with the brim of its hat.
description.zh: 誕生時就戴著皮革製帽子的數碼寶貝。因為擁有防具，讓孜孜獸看起來比一般的幼年期更強，但帽子是以柔軟的材料製成，並沒有多少防禦力。在個性上擁有很強的戒心，馬上就會躲進帽子裡。必殺技是用帽沿去戳對手的「砰砰」。

description.en: An extremely rare Digimon from a small population. There are precious few Dragon Digimon at the In-Training level, and it’s said that most of their number either perish or are captured before they can fully develop. Though it might not look like it, Jyarimon’s mouth is lined with tiny fangs, a sign that it will grow into a powerful dragon Digimon. Despite being weak, it seems drawn to anything larger than it, and this is another reason for its abysmally low survival rate. It attacks using Heated Bubbles, which it produces with its naturally high body heat.
description.zh: 個體數量稀少，非常稀有的數碼寶貝。幼年期的龍系數碼寶貝數量極其稀少，據說大多數都會在成長前遭到捕捉或滅絕。雖然從外表看不出來，但嘴裡長著密密麻麻的細小牙齒，能預見沙礫獸將來會成為力量強大的龍系數碼寶貝。沙礫獸雖然弱小無力，卻有會朝著比自己體型更大的物體前去的性質，這也成為其生存率低的原因。體內總是處於高溫狀態，會用帶熱氣的泡泡攻擊。

description.en: An Unidentified Digimon that suddenly appeared on a computer network. A single Digi-Egg was born from the malice of humans abusing computer networks and the aggression from conflicts unfolding over networks. The Digi-Egg was the amalgamation of humanity’s destructive instincts, and the mysterious Digimon born from it is incredibly dangerous. It multiplies within a computer network like a virus, causing minor network failures. It uses its special move Glare Eye to produce a frothy substance from its giant eye.
description.zh: 突然現身於電腦網路，真實身分不明的數碼寶貝。濫用電腦網路之人的惡意，還有人類在網路上展開的爭執所產生的攻擊性化為具體的形式，誕生出了一顆數碼蛋。這顆數碼蛋凝縮了人類的破壞本能，從中誕生的神祕數碼寶貝是十分危險的存在。水母獸會在電腦網路中像病原體般繁殖，引發輕度網路故障。必殺技是從特大的眼睛中噴出泡沫狀物體的「眼之強光」。

description.en: A Slime Digimon with a breath of fresh verdure (a small leaf) on its tail. Leafmon has many elements of a plant, and its body contains chlorophyll, allowing it to grow through photosynthesis. It protects itself from harsh sunlight and rain with its leaf-shaped tail. Leafmon’s pure nature prevents it from fearing or doubting the opponent. That being said, it has a bit of a shy side. This newborn Digimon cannot fight, but its innocent heart brimming with life force makes others recall pure feelings once forgotten, wrapping those around it in an air of tranquility. Still, if anyone messes with it too much, it will spit Acid Bubbles to threaten them.
description.zh: 尾巴有著新綠氣息（小葉子）的軟泥型數碼寶貝。綠葉獸擁有大量的植物要素，身體成分含有葉綠素，會透過光合作用成長。有著葉子形狀的尾巴，陽光強烈或是下雨時會用那個葉子來遮蔽。個性天真單純，不會害怕或是懷疑他人，但有點容易害羞。由於是剛出生的狀態，因此無法戰鬥，但綠葉獸充滿生命力的天真內心會令人想起快要忘掉的單純心情，讓周遭人們包覆在沉穩的氣氛之中。不過要是對綠葉獸戲弄過頭，綠葉獸便會吐出酸性泡泡來威嚇喔。

description.en: A Seed Digimon whose body is covered in a layer of transparent tissue, under which a body akin to a variant of Botamon can be seen. Nyokimon is thought to be a grass version of the Botamon type. This means that it could Digivolve not just into a Vegetation Digimon, but possibly into a Dragon-species Digimon as well. It has a gentle personality, as well as a hint of timidity. Nyokimon lacks attack power, and uses Seed Cracker to surprise its enemies and run off in a hurry.
description.zh: 身體表面被透明體組織覆蓋著的種子型數碼寶貝。透明表皮裡的本體似乎是黑球獸的變種。研判是黑球獸種植物化的姿態。因此豆苗獸不只能進化成植物系數碼寶貝，也蘊含著能進化成龍系等數碼寶貝的可能性。個性極為溫和，也有著膽小的一面。會射出不具有攻擊力的彈跳種子「爆種」，趁對手受到驚嚇時迅速逃走。

description.en: This bubble Digimon looks like a mere sea-green bubble at first glance, but it is actually a totally autonomous creature with a plethora of expressions. Pabumon’s delicate surface means it has practically no defense or prowess in combat. It creates infinite tiny foam clones from the pacifier-like object in its mouth. This ability was originally used to develop computer viruses, but its lack of life force made for poor implementation. Life is fleeting for this adorable Digimon baby. The Adhesive Bubble Blow released from its body binds enemies, giving it a chance to escape.
description.zh: 乍看之下只是淡綠色泡沫卻能夠自由行動，表情也很豐富的泡沫型數碼寶貝。由於表面尚未凝固，等同沒有防禦力，並不適合戰鬥。看起來像是嘴上含著奶嘴的部分可以製造出小型泡沫，讓泡沫無限地增殖。這種增殖性曾經差點就被用來開發電腦病毒，所幸因為泡沫獸生命力太弱而沒有執行。雖然生命薄弱，依然拚命生存著，是令人疼愛的數碼寶貝寶寶。擅長利用體內產生的黏著性泡泡封住外敵的行動，趁機逃跑。

description.en: A microbe-like Digimon discovered in the Net Ocean, the place studied as the birthplace of all life in the Digital World. Pichimon lives by emotion alone, moving about in an extremely hectic fashion. Full of curiosity, it longs to communicate with the outside world, but has yet to figure out how. Even so, this Digimon baby is cherished by all, and its big red eyes are charming enough to shake any enemy’s resolve. It can spit soap-like bubbles from its mouth to blind the enemy, letting it escape.
description.zh: 發現比基獸的地方，是從以前就一直備受研究，視為數碼世界內生命誕生地的「網路之海」。比基獸是微生物般的數碼寶貝，在眾多的數碼寶貝之中體型最小。似乎完全依循感情而活，行動多變到令人眼花撩亂。好奇心非常旺盛，強烈希望與外界交流，但尚未獲得交流手段。不過，比基獸大大的鮮紅眼珠充滿著可以動搖對方感情的魅力，是人見人愛的數碼寶貝寶寶。會從口中吐出肥皂泡般的泡泡，遮蔽敵方的視線之後逃跑。

description.en: This Digimon baby uses its translucent body to float along the Net Ocean like a jellyfish. Possessing the most primitive makeup of any discovered Digimon, it garners attention from Digital World anthropologists and Digimon fanatics alike. They hail it as a “missing link,” potentially capable of unlocking the mystery behind Digimon. It uses Super Acid Bubbles to protect itself from foes.
description.zh: 身體呈半透明，在「網路之海」如水母般漂浮著的數碼寶貝嬰兒。身體構造是至今發現的數碼寶貝之中最原始的，被研究數碼寶貝起源的學者與狂熱者視為解開數碼寶貝誕生之謎的關鍵「失落環節」，備受矚目。為了保護自己不受外敵攻擊，會從嘴裡吐出強力的酸性泡泡。

description.en: A brand new type of Digimon. Three protrusions grow from the top of its gelatinous, red body. It can’t fight, but threatens enemies with Acidic bubbles.
description.zh: 剛出生的新種數碼寶貝。紅色的凝膠狀身體柔軟又具有彈性，頭部長著三根像是觸手的東西。無法進行戰鬥，只會吐出酸性很強的泡沫威嚇敵人。

description.en: A Slime Digimon with gossamer wings sprouting from a light, bubble-like body. Pupumon’s rather large eyeballs are very sensitive to the motion of objects, allowing it to flee at any sign of movement. Even so, it is no coward, and will fight back in the face of continued bullying. When enemies approach, it blows Poison Bubbles to attack.
description.zh: 泡沫般輕盈的身體上長著輕薄翅膀的軟泥型數碼寶貝。有點大的眼珠子對於物體的動態相當敏感，一旦捕捉某些動靜就會馬上飛走，但普普獸並非膽小，若是一直欺負普普獸，普普獸便會反擊。敵人一靠近便會從口中吐出「毒性泡泡」進行攻擊。

description.en: A Slime Digimon with a chubby, silicon-like body that jiggles around when it wriggles forward. Pururumon’s small fins are surprisingly dexterous, letting it scratch itchy spots on its body, but not allowing it to fly. It loves the smell of the sun, sprawling out on days with nice weather while sniffing the grass, immersed in a happy mood. When things get dicey, Pururumon will dribble out Acid Bubbles, covering the enemy and escaping in the interim.
description.zh: 胖嘟嘟的身體像是矽膠似的，爬行前進時身子會有搖晃起伏的軟泥型數碼寶貝。小小的雙鰭意外地靈巧，能夠抵達難以到達的地方，但還無法飛行。最喜歡陽光的味道，會在天氣好的日子趴在草皮上，嗅著草的氣味沉浸在幸福的心情裡。遇到危機時會吐出酸性泡泡讓對手身上充滿泡沫，再趁機逃跑。

description.en: A Baby Bird Digimon covered in soft feathers. Puwamon has extremely keen eyesight and can survey a vast area, allowing it to react instantly to any movement in the vicinity. Inquisitive by nature, this Digimon lacks shyness and gets along easily with others, garnering it a degree of popularity. That being said, Puwamon absolutely despises having its tail touched. Be warned; doing so thoughtlessly will cause it to bathe the culprit in a blinding down known as Fluffy Feather.
description.zh: 全身覆蓋著柔軟羽毛的雛鳥型數碼寶貝。有著非常好的視力，能看見的範圍也相當廣，因此對於周遭的風吹草動能即時反應。綿綿獸有著好奇心旺盛的個性，不怕生又親人的個性讓這種數碼寶貝開始受到歡迎。但綿綿獸極度討厭別人觸碰其尾巴，若是不小心碰到，綿綿獸便會使出「柔羽」用羽毛把你的眼睛遮起來，需要留意。

description.en: A mystical Digimon said to be born only on moonlit nights. A Relemon born under the full moon is said to receive its magic power, and will grow into a Digimon with above-average abilities that can use mysterious arts. A nocturnal creature, its shy personality prevents it from appearing in front of people often. Relemon cannot attack, but it can transform into anything of a similar size to itself as a form of protection. It cannot hide its tail, however, and therefore it is always found out.
description.zh: 據說只會在有月亮的晚上誕生的神祕數碼寶貝。尤其是在滿月夜晚出生的狐裘獸會接收滿月的魔力，據說可成長為比其他數碼寶貝能力更強，能使出不可思議法術的數碼寶貝。狐裘獸是夜行性，生性害羞，鮮少出現在人前。雖然無法攻擊，但能變化成任何與自己體型相近的東西來保護自身。只不過，狐裘獸總是藏不住尾巴而被發現。

description.en: A small Digimon with a single blade on its head. Sakumon’s whole body is a golden hue, and its head blade shines brightly. It has a mischievous personality, and is seen in constant movement during its waking hours. Still, Sakumon is very unbalanced due to the weight of its head, causing it to roll around waving its blade. Digimon are often seen trying to escape from such movements.
description.zh: 頭部長出一把刀刃的小型數碼寶貝。全身呈現金色，頭部的刀刃閃閃發亮。個性淘氣，醒著的時候總是四處活動，但由於頭部的重量導致平衡感不佳，有時會看到薩庫獸揮著刀刃滾在地上，讓周圍其他數碼寶貝四處逃竄的景象。

description.en: This In-Training Digimon looks like a seed, but it is no Plant-species Digimon. Tsubumon cannot fly, but can move by bouncing along any surface—ground, water, you name it. Some say there is no place it cannot go. Still, its small body is sent flying on blustery days, leading to the common misconception that it is a Plant type. Tsubumon uses its signature move Acid Bubbles to drive off foes.
description.zh: 幼年期數碼寶貝，外表像是種子，卻不是植物系數碼寶貝。雖然無法飛行，但不論在陸地還是水上都能以跳躍的方式移動，據說可以移動到任何地方。然而，在颳強風的日子，其嬌小的身軀會被吹飛，也因此經常被錯認為植物系數碼寶貝。擅長的招式「酸性泡泡」可用來趕跑敵人。

description.en: A Digimon baby with fluffy white hairs covering its entire body. Considered a variant of Botamon, YukimiBotamon gained its name from its white body, but the details are unknown. It is weak to fire, and tends to prefer chilly places. YukimiBotamon’s body is also cold to the touch. It uses its Diamond Dust attack to blow freezing cold air from its mouth. This causes moisture to freeze in the air, and then to fall with a glittering sparkle that resembles diamonds.
description.zh: 全身覆蓋著一層蓬鬆的雪白纖毛寶寶般的數碼寶貝。雪球獸被視為是黑球獸的一種，因為體色雪白而被命名為「雪球獸」，但是詳情不明。生性怕熱，喜歡寒冷的地方，身體摸起來涼涼的。攻擊技是吐出冰冷氣息的「鑽石星塵」。當雪球獸吐氣時，空氣中的水分會凝固，並閃爍著光芒掉落地面。

description.en: A Seed Digimon covered in a soft, furry substance all over its body. When it hatches from its Digi-Eggs, Yuramon blows through the air like a dandelion seed, seeking out an environment suited to its growth. When it finds a good environment devoid of enemies, it lands and begins preparations for Digivolution. Yuramon has next to no attack strength, but can use Adhesive Bubble Blow to interfere with enemy movement and give it a chance to escape.
description.zh: 全身覆蓋著細長軟毛般物質的種子型數碼寶貝。從數碼蛋孵化之後，為了尋找最適合成長的環境，像蒲公英的種子般飄浮在空中。一旦找到沒有外敵的好環境就會降落在地上，準備開始進化。幾乎沒有攻擊力，會吐出黏著性泡泡延緩對手的行動，再趁機逃走。

description.en: Extremely rare Digimon born in pairs from a single Digi-Egg. Why Zerimon and Conomon are the only Digimon that can be born as twins is currently unknown. Even more confusingly, sometimes instead of being born with a twin of the same type, one Zerimon and one Conomon will hatch from the same Digi-Egg. Zerimon, with its single horn, tends to be highly energetic, while three-horned Conomon is generally more subdued. Also, unlike other Slime Digimon, the horn on Zerimon’s head is surprisingly tough. Like other In-Training Digimon, Zerimon spits Acid Bubbles to threaten its enemies.
description.zh: 從一顆數碼蛋中誕生出兩隻，相當稀有的數碼寶貝。為何只有果凍獸和可可獸是以雙胞胎的形式誕生，現階段尚未明瞭。而且果凍獸與可可獸並非一定會以雙胞胎形式誕生，也有分別從單顆數碼蛋中誕生的例子。相對於一隻角，非常活潑的果凍獸，有著三隻角的可可獸個性較為內斂。此外，與其他軟泥型數碼寶貝不同，果凍獸頭部的角意外地很堅硬。與其他幼年期數碼寶貝相同，會吐出酸性泡泡威嚇敵人。

description.en: A Vegetation Digimon blending data from various poisonous plants, taking on the look of a plant bud. It usually floats through the air on its leaves, and won’t attack unless provoked. Budmon uses its special move Poisonous Thorns to hurt anything that touches it. If angered, it may even fire off these thorns.
description.zh: 種種有毒植物的數據混合在一起，外貌有如花蕾的植物型數碼寶貝。平常會乘坐在葉子上，在空中飄蕩，在空中飄盪，只要什麼都不做，就不會主動攻擊。必殺技是碰到會很痛的「毒刺刺」。要是生氣，有時候也會射出棘刺。

description.en: Despite resembling an aquatic dinosaur infant, Bukamon is a playful Digimon that can move as skillfully as a seahorse. However, the friendliness of Pichimon seems to have vanished, and Bukamon is quick to flee when others draw near. Since its skin still isn’t fit for the high pressure and low temperature of the ocean’s depths, Bukamon can only spend a limited amount of time submerged in the deep.
description.zh: 有著讓人聯想到水棲恐龍幼體的外表，但動作卻有如海馬般靈活，是個開朗的數碼寶貝。然而比基獸時期親近人的個性已經不在，只要有人靠近就會迅速逃走。外皮還無法承受深海的水壓與低溫，所以能潛入深海的時間也不長。

description.en: A Mini Angel Digimon that Digivolved from Puttimon. Unlike how it was during its time as Puttimon, Cupimon likes doing good deeds, and loves bringing everyone happiness. It is actually referred to as the “Angel of Charity,” and specializes in fostering feelings of love within people. Cupimon is always flying around the skies of the Digital World, lavishing love upon everyone and making them happy. Even large Digimon that are filled with belligerence are said to stop fighting when they meet Cupimon. It uses its special move Angel Ring to generate a ring of holy light from the protrusion on its forehead and hurl it at the enemy.
description.zh: 由巴特獸進化而成的小天使型數碼寶貝。丘比獸與巴特獸不同，喜歡行善，最喜歡的事情是讓大家變幸福。甚至還被稱為「博愛天使」，擅長將「愛」帶給人們。經常飛翔於數碼世界的空中散播愛、讓人們變幸福。據說即使是擁有強烈鬥爭意識的大型數碼寶貝，遇上丘比獸也會停止戰鬥。必殺技是從頭頂突起處製造神聖光環、丟向敵人的「天使之環」。

description.en: DemiMeramon is a Digivolution of Mokumon. Its DigiCore burns with great intensity despite its small frame, and as a result its body is constantly wrapped in flames. Highly volatile for its size, its DigiCore burns at a fever-pitch, and it has an aggressive personality. Since it doesn’t pack much of a punch, though, it’s not very effective in a fight. It also struggles to deal with water, ice, and snow Digimon. If it ever meets one, it will immediately run away. Incidentally, its connection to Meramon is not yet fully understood. DemiMeramon attacks its foes by firing a Small Flame Shot from its mouth, but it’s not very strong.
description.zh: 由煙塵獸進化而成的數碼寶貝。儘管身體嬌小卻用勁燃燒數碼核心，才會呈現全身燃燒的模樣。雖然是小型的數碼寶貝卻生性暴躁，因此小火焰獸讓數碼核心燃燒得十分旺盛，個性好戰。不過小火焰獸攻擊力低，無法好好戰鬥。而且小火焰獸相當不擅長對付水系與冰雪系的數碼寶貝，一碰到就會立刻逃跑。順帶一提，目前還不清楚小火焰獸與火焰獸之間有什麼關聯。小火焰獸能夠從口中噴出小火焰彈攻擊對手，但是威力並不大。

description.en: A Baby Dragon Digimon that Digivolved from Chibomon. DemiVeemon has a torso and limbs—rare features for In-Training Digimon—allowing it to grab objects in its small hands and bounce around. A glutton by nature, it especially enjoys sweets. DemiVeemon also loves sleeping, and will be found fast asleep the moment after you take your eyes off of it. It hops around and tackles the enemy with its special move Hop Attack.
description.zh: 芝高獸進化而成的幼龍型數碼寶貝。擁有身體與雙手雙腳，在幼年期數碼寶貝之中相當少見。能夠用小小的兩手抓住物品，並以雙腳一邊跳躍一邊移動。食慾相當旺盛，特別喜歡甜食。另外還非常喜歡睡覺，只要一不注意豆丁獸，豆丁獸就會立刻睡著。必殺技是一邊跳躍一邊撞向對手的「蹦跳攻擊」。

description.en: A four-legged In-Training Digimon that grew from a Jyarimon. Its physical features resemble that of Tokomon, including the powerful fangs in its mouth. Unlike Tokomon, who Digivolves into Mammal types, Gigimon—who Digivolves into Dragon types—has a violent personality, and is savage despite its minuscule stature. More than a few large Digimon are deceived by its appearance, and end up paying the price when it fights back. It uses its special move Hot Bite to chomp down on the opponent. Gigimon’s body is hot like Jyarimon’s, causing burns on whatever it bites.
description.zh: 沙礫獸成長後的四足型幼年期數碼寶貝。身體的特徵與迪哥獸十分相似，口中也長有強而有力的牙齒。不過，與進化為哺乳類系的迪哥獸不同，基基獸是進化為龍系數碼寶貝，脾氣也相當暴躁，體型雖小卻很凶狠。有不少大型數碼寶貝被基基獸的外表欺騙而受到反擊。必殺技是咬住對手的「熱咬」。基基獸與沙礫獸一樣體溫偏高，據說被基基獸咬到的地方會變成燙傷。

description.en: A Digimon that grew from Zerimon. Cheerful and lively by nature, it inherits an energetic personality from Zerimon. Although it is bigger than before, its body composition remains as unstable and squishy as ever. Just like Zerimon, however, Gummymon’s horn has hardened, which allows it to menace foes with headbutts. The biggest physical change from Zerimon are its body and the ear-like protrusions sprouting from its head. It uses its special move Double Bobble to blow a large number of adhesive bubbles.
description.zh: 果凍獸成長後的數碼寶貝。承襲了果凍獸充滿朝氣的個性，相當開朗活潑。雖然有所成長，但身體組織仍不穩定，全身軟綿綿。不過角的部分和果凍獸一樣相當堅硬，會用頭擊來威嚇敵人。與果凍獸相比，最大的變化是從頭部長出了身體與類似耳朵的部位。必殺技是吐出許多黏性泡沫的「雙重泡泡」。

description.en: Kakkinmon is a Digimon whose leather hat has become a copper shield, and it has grown harsher as a result. With stronger defenses, it’s become less cautious, and now has a tendency to charge into things without fear. But since its shield is still only made of copper, it’s in for a painful lesson if it gets too reckless. Its special move is Clang-Clang, which involves crashing into foes with the sharp corners of its shield.
description.zh: 頭上的帽子變成銅製的盾，長相也更加老成的數碼寶貝。由於護具變得堅固而降低戒心，性格也變得衝動不怕事。不過護具還只是普通的銅盾，恪勤獸衝過頭的話反而會吃苦頭。必殺技是用盾尖銳的地方刺向對手的「噹噹」。

description.en: A spider-shaped Rookie Digimon that moves in tandem with Dokugumon. KoDokugumon is usually gentle, rolling up into a ball and hanging from tree branches and the like. But when enemies approach, it will drop down from above with its brethren to attack. It can’t produce strong poison yet, and so wears gloves that inject strong poison from claws at the tips. KoDokugumon uses its special move Poison Nails to scratch the enemy with its poison claw gloves.
description.zh: 與蜘蛛獸一同集體行動，外貌有如蜘蛛的成長期數碼寶貝。平常會靜靜地把身體蜷成球狀，垂吊在樹枝等處，一旦敵方靠近就會集體從敵人頭頂發動攻擊。由於還無法製造出劇毒，在爪子上套了暗藏強烈毒素的手套。必殺技是以毒爪子手套劃傷敵人的「劇毒之爪」。

description.en: A small Digimon whose body has grown a size bigger, its peach fuzz having fallen off. Koromon can move around vigorously, but combat is still beyond its capabilities. It blows Foam from its mouth to intimidate foes.
description.zh: 披覆於表面的胎毛脫落，身體也大了一圈的小型數碼寶貝。雖然開始能活潑地四處跑，卻還無法戰鬥。會從嘴裡噴出泡沫以威嚇敵人。

description.en: Minomon is a Digivolution of Leafmon, having gained a tough outer shell. On days that have nice weather or when it’s in a good mood, Minomon will poke its head out of its shell and veg out.It uses the vines of ivy "hair" that grows from its head to hang down from high places or get around by dangling from a larger Digimon. Alternatively, it can move over shorter distances by floating. Its two biggest faults are its idle personality and its generally neutral expression. Still, it has a strong inner core that keeps it from getting discouraged despite its worries and its fears, and it deals well with being alone. Its special move is Pinecone, by which it throws a hard, pinecone-like object at foes.
description.zh: 由綠葉獸進化而成，窩在硬殼裡的數碼寶貝。天氣好的時候或心情好的時候，幼蟲獸會把頭探出殼外發呆。會用長在頭上的藤蔓(毛髮？)把自己懸掛在高處，或是吊在大型數碼寶貝身上移動，也能夠在短距離內漂浮於空中移動。個性散漫，缺點是很少表露出自己的情緒。另外，幼蟲獸很堅強且「擅長」獨處，即使感到不安或憂慮，也不會因此受挫。必殺技是擲出松毬狀堅硬物體的「松球」。

description.en: A Machine Digimon with a missile body. Its missile is ignited the moment it Digivolves into Missimon, and it continues to fly until it Digivolves to another form. It can adjust its speed somewhat, but will crash unless it maintains considerable speed, so it cannot stop in one place. Missile Crash uses this speed for a body slam overflowing with destructive force, but it almost never lands due to Missimon’s lack of control.
description.zh: 有著導彈身體的機械型數碼寶貝。在進化成飛彈獸的瞬間，導彈就已經點燃了，所以在進化為下一種數碼寶貝前會一直飛行。雖然多多少少能夠調整速度，但要是飛行的速度不夠快就會墜落，因此飛彈獸不可能停留在同一個地方。利用其速度來撞擊的「飛彈重擊」破壞力十足，但因為還無法好好控制，幾乎不會擊中目標。

description.en: A mollusklike Digimon with highly elastic skin, Motimon uses the protrusions beneath its body to waggle its way around. The name “Motimon” comes from its resemblance to mochi when it puffs up its body in excitement. Despite its appearance, Motimon possesses a surprisingly high degree of intelligence, and so is believed to have developed from a computer dictionary. Capable of understanding human language, Motimon can occasionally be seen altering the shape of its body in an effort at communication. Motimon uses its mochi-like Elastic Bubbles to restrict opponents’ movement.
description.zh: 獲得了具有伸縮性的外皮，利用身體下方突起部蹣跚行走的軟體數碼寶貝。興奮的時候身體會膨脹，看起來就像年糕一樣，因此被稱為「年糕獸」。然而年糕獸擁有從外表看不出來的高智力，所以推測年糕獸是誕生自電腦的辭典功能。年糕獸可以理解人類的語言，不時可以看見年糕獸讓身體任意變形，試圖與人類溝通的模樣。能夠放出像年糕一樣的伸縮性泡泡來封住對手的行動。

description.en: A small Digimon with feline traits. Always whimsical, Nyaromon received its name for its cat-like behavior. While curious and fickle by equal measures, it has a lonely side as well. It uses its special move Fox Tail to whip the enemy with the wiry hairs on its tail. Not a single foe has ever been seen flinching under this attack.
description.zh: 特徵像貓的小型數碼寶貝。總是隨心所欲，行為舉止就像是「貓」一樣──這似乎就是被取名為貓貓獸的原因。好奇心相當旺盛，變心的速度很快，但是也有容易寂寞的一面。必殺技是膨脹尾巴，讓毛變得像鐵絲一樣擊向敵人的「妖狐之尾」。不過，至今仍未看見任何敵人被這種攻擊嚇到。

description.en: A small Digimon that can perform low-altitude flight with the ear-like appendages on its head. Pagumon can move its ears skillfully, using them like hands. In fact, it will often mockingly pull down the enemy’s eyelids, or slap the enemy’s rear. This Digimon loves pranks. It often teases the likes of Koromon or Tsunomon, chasing them around and around. It may spit Poison Bubbles from its mouth to bully other Digimon.
description.zh: 小型數碼寶貝，能夠靠長在頭部像是耳朵的東西低空飛行。透過靈巧的操縱，柏古獸能把耳朵當成手來用。柏古獸平時會表現出瞧不起人的態度，像是刻意擺鬼臉唱反調，或者做出「打我屁股啊笨蛋」的舉止。柏古獸的性格相當壞心眼。經常追在滾球獸和獨角獸後頭，欺負對方。有時也會從嘴裡吐出「毒性泡泡」捉弄人。

description.en: A Baby Bird Digimon that runs around in constant motion. Pinamon’s emotions come across in the way it runs, and it will not stop unless it feels apathetic or is asleep. Its face does not display any emotion, and its feelings have to be read from its running style, making this Digimon hard to deal with. Like Puwamon, Pinamon loathes having its tail touched. This causes it to launch the miniature electric attack Tingling Spark from its tail, so this creature warrants even more caution than Puwamon.
description.zh: 總是匆匆忙忙來回跑動的雛鳥型數碼寶貝。會以跑步方式呈現喜怒哀樂的感情，因此除了沒興致或睡覺的時候以外，從不停下腳步。不會將感情表現在臉上，必須從跑步的方式來領會其感情，是很難接觸的數碼寶貝。皮那獸和綿綿獸一樣很討厭被觸碰尾巴，由於皮那獸的尾巴會釋放出微量的電擊「霹啪火花」，必須比觸碰綿綿獸的尾巴時更加留意。

description.en: A Mini Bird Digimon that Digivolved from Pururumon, and which is now capable of low-level flight. Poromon has wings, which is quite rare for an In-Training Digimon, and its body is covered in small, downy feathers. Its most charming feature is the ornamental feather on its head, which it cares for with single-minded devotion. Poromon likes to keep things neat and tidy, but since it can’t turn its head (?) to clean itself, it relies on others to stay well-groomed. Its signature move, Pororo Breeze, involves flapping its tiny wings to kick up a cloud of dust. Then, when its opponent flinches, it runs away.
description.zh: 從震震獸進化而成，能夠在低空飛行的小鳥型數碼寶貝。身體長滿了小小的羽毛，在幼年期數碼寶貝之中有翅膀的個體相當少見。魅力之處在於戴在頭上的羽飾，鈍鈍獸清潔羽飾時非常用心。基本上喜歡乾淨整潔，不過就算鈍鈍獸想清理羽毛，脖子(？)也轉不動，因此鈍鈍獸會互相幫忙清理。擅長的招式是「鈍鈍微風」，拍打小巧的翅膀捲起沙塵，趁著對手被嚇到的時候逃跑。

description.en: An In-Training Digimon that Digivolved from Sakumon to have two blades. The blades on its left and right sides, as well as its new legs, have provided Sakuttomon more stability. It has stopped rolling around and become more active, but can get stuck on the ceiling or walls and stop moving.
description.zh: 由薩庫獸進化而成，刀刃變成兩把的幼年期數碼寶貝。刀刃變成位於左右兩側，又長出了小小的腳，因而有了穩定的平衡感。不會跌倒，動作也變得更加活潑，但一刺進天花板或牆壁就會動彈不得。

description.en: Tanemon is a Bulb Digimon with what appears to be a seedling sprouting from its head. It Digivolved from Yuramon when it landed on the ground after drifting through the air in search of the perfect environment. Extremely skittish, Tanemon will use its four legs to quickly dig a hole so it can hide its body at the first sign of a threat. While its body is hidden underground, the seedling on its head makes it indistinguishable from a plant, protecting it from harm. However, this strategy is ineffective against herbivorous Digimon.
description.zh: 頭部有著類似植物嫩芽的發芽物體，球根型數碼寶貝。由尋找最舒適環境而飄遊的浮球獸降落地面進化而成。個性非常膽小，只要察覺外敵的存在，就會以四隻腳挖洞並將身體埋進地底。一旦埋進地底，從頭部生長出來的東西就會擬態成植物，藉此保護自身不受外敵攻擊。只不過，這招對草食性數碼寶貝不管用。

description.en: A small Digimon with four limbs extending from underneath its body (head?). These limbs, which are highly unusual on an In-Training Digimon, give Tokomon a unique and extremely cute look. However, that cuteness can be deceptive, and anyone who reaches out to pet Tokomon may be in for a surprise as it quickly opens its mouth and bites down with its rows of sharp teeth. Tokomon has an innocent personality, though, and doesn’t mean any real harm.
description.zh: 身體（頭？）的下方長著手腳般部位的小型數碼寶貝。長出手腳的幼年期數碼寶貝十分罕見，外表也極為可愛。然而，如果只是因為可愛就貿然伸出手，迪哥獸就會突然張開大嘴巴，用長得密密麻麻的牙齒咬下去，千萬要留意。話雖如此，迪哥獸的個性十分天真無邪，並沒有惡意。

description.en: An In-Training Digimon that Digivolved beyond Kuramon. The tips of its feelers are shaped like talons, increasing its ferocity. Tsumemon corrodes data at frightening speed, causing networks to malfunction. Its movement speed is just as fast, making it difficult to catch once it’s Digivolved to this level. It uses its special move Nail Scratch to rake with the talons on its feelers.
description.zh: 由水母獸進化而成的幼年期數碼寶貝。觸手前端變成鉤爪狀，個性也變得更加凶暴。會以驚人的速度侵蝕數據，使網路失控。另外移動的速度也很快，如果進化成妖爪獸，就會變得更難捕獲。必殺技是用觸手鉤爪砍向敵人的「釘之刻痕」。

description.en: A small Digimon with a single horn on its head formed by hardening one of Punimon’s feelers. Having Digivolved to be more animalistic than Punimon, Tsunomon is covered in soft fur. Filled with a playful spirit, it loves to pull pranks, and has yet to develop its instinct for conflict.
description.zh: 普尼獸頭部的觸手之一產生硬化的小型數碼寶貝。從普尼獸進化得更像動物，長滿了綿密的體毛。個性依然貪玩，也喜歡惡作劇，但戰鬥本能尚未覺醒。

description.en: An In-Training Digimon that eats rocks to grow. Since Tumblemon’s digestive system isn’t fully developed yet, it holds a surprisingly large amount of ore in its small body that it slowly converts into nutrients. Also, since its eye is located in the same place as its mouth, Tumblemon is unable to see anything while it’s eating. Its signature move is Rock Breath, by which it spits out rocks from its large mouth.
description.zh: 吞食石頭成長的幼年期數碼寶貝。由於消化器官尚未完全成熟，會讓數量驚人的礦石儲存在嬌小的身體裡，並隨著時間慢慢轉化為養分。眼睛所在的位置也能用來當作嘴巴，因此吃東西的時候似乎會完全看不到四周。擅長的招式是從大嘴裡吐出石頭的「岩石之息」。

description.en: An In-Training Amphibian Digimon with ear-like gills growing from both sides of its body. Upamon can live both underwater and on land, but seems more suited to life above the waves. Its carefree attitude makes it an easy target for teasing by other Digimon. But it is that attitude that often causes Upamon to misconstrue such teasing as playing. It uses its special move Shock Shout to release an ultrasonic shout, causing the enemy to recoil.
description.zh: 幼年期兩棲型數碼寶貝，身體兩側長著像是耳朵般的鰓。雖然能夠生活於陸地與水中，但是似乎更適合陸地的環境。個性悠哉，因此容易被其他數碼寶貝欺負。不過，因為奧柏獸少根筋，所以會誤以為大家是在跟自己玩，而不是在欺負自己。必殺技是發出超高音的尖叫聲嚇退敵人的「激動叫喊」。

description.en: A nocturnal In-Training Digimon that Digivolved from Relemon. It only moves around on moonlit nights, so its existence is considered close to an illusion. For this reason, Tamers treat a Viximon as a sort of status symbol. Depending on how it’s raised, it can grow into an incredibly reassuring Digimon. Viximon always moves so as not to be seen, and few can observe its speed with the naked eye. Still, set out its favorite food of fried tofu, and will appear out of thin air. Its special move Killing Stone turns it to stone and makes it emit a poisonous gas.
description.zh: 由狐裘獸進化而成的夜行性幼年期數碼寶貝。雖然晝伏夜出，不過小狐獸只會在月光明亮的夜晚行動，而被視為夢幻般的存在。因此在馴獸師之中，能夠培育小狐獸也是一種地位的象徵。根據培育方式的不同，有機會成長為意志十分堅強的數碼寶貝。小狐獸行動時總是會小心不被發現，而且從外表難以想像那矯捷的身手。雖然相當難捕捉，不過只要拿出小狐獸最愛的炸豆皮，小狐獸就會忍不住現身。必殺技是變成石頭，噴出毒氣的「殺生石」。

description.en: A Bulb Digimon with a big flower blooming on its head. Yokomon moves by deftly manipulating its root-like tentacles, and is able to float softly through the air, albeit for short distances. A curious creature, its restless movements are delightful to behold. Yokomon tend to live in groups—from dozens to hundreds.
description.zh: 頭上盛開著一大朵花的球根型微小數碼寶貝。比高獸能夠藉由操控如根一般的觸手移動身體，而且能夠輕飄飄地浮在空中，不過高度不高。好奇心旺盛，不停來回移動的樣子十分可愛。有群居的習性，根據群體不同有數隻到數百隻的差異。

description.en: A Reptile Digimon that’s developed the ability to walk on two legs, similar in appearance to a tiny dinosaur. Since Agumon isn’t fully matured, it lacks strength, but its fierce disposition makes it reckless. Hard, sharp claws grow from its limbs, and Agumon makes full use of them in battle. Agumon shows much potential, promising Digivolution into a great and powerful Digimon. Its special move is Pepper Breath, by which it spits flames at its foes.
description.zh: 成長為能夠用雙腳行走，外表如小型恐龍般的爬蟲類型數碼寶貝。由於還在成長途中，所以力量薄弱，但個性相當凶猛且天不怕地不怕。雙手雙腳都長有堅硬的利爪，能在戰鬥中發揮威力。可預見亞古獸將進化成擁有力量的偉大數碼寶貝。必殺技是從口中吐出火焰氣息攻擊敵人的「小型火焰」。

description.en: A Mammal Digimon clad head-to-toe in a sturdy carapace. Easy-going and courteous, but sometimes pushes its luck. Armadillomon is a descendant of the same ancient species as Veemon, so it can perform a special Armor Digivolution. It uses its signature move Scratch Beat to attack the enemy with extended front claws. It can launch its curled-up body at the enemy with its special move Diamond Shell.
description.zh: 全身覆蓋著堅硬甲殼的哺乳類型數碼寶貝。不拘小節且個性受人喜愛，但有著容易得意忘形的小缺點。穿山獸和V仔獸等數碼寶貝一樣是古代種族的末裔，因此能進行特殊的裝甲進化。擅長的招式是用長長的前腳腳爪攻擊敵人，名稱為「穿山爪」。必殺技是將身體捲成一球，衝向敵人的「滾動攻擊」。

description.en: A Baby Bird Digimon with arm-like wings. Biyomon can use these to dexterously grip objects, though this limits its ability to fly. Biyomon spends most of its time on the ground, but can escape into the air when danger draws near. Since it’s similar in flying ability to Patamon, Biyomon sees Patamon as a rival. Biyomon’s dream is to one day Digivolve into Birdramon and fly freely through the sky. Its nightmare is becoming Kokatorimon, who cannot fly at all. Possessed of an inquisitive mind, Biyomon likes to peck at the sprout growing from Tanemon’s head. Biyomon’s special move is Spiral Twister, an attack of spectral flames.
description.zh: 翅膀部分有如手臂般發達的雛鳥型數碼寶貝。雖然能靈活運用翅膀來抓握物體，但也因此不擅長飛行。比丘獸平時生活在陸地上，但遇到危險就會飛上天空逃走。但比丘獸的飛行能力和巴達獸差不多，也將巴達獸視為勁敵。想是將來成為能隨心所欲在天空翱翔的巴多拉獸，似乎不想成為不會飛的巨雞獸。比丘獸有著好奇心旺盛的個性，喜歡啄種子獸的頭部。必殺技是幻影之焰「魔法火焰」。

description.en: A Fire Digimon that burns with intensity, its DigiCore—considered the heart of a Digimon—sitting on its head. Candlemon cannot maintain its vital functions if the DigiCore flame above its head goes out. One theory suggests that the flame above its head is actually its true form, with the body underneath acting as a decoy. Candlemon has a gentle personality for a Fire Digimon, and will not cause harm to those around it. It uses its special move Bonfire to cough up a small ball of fire.
description.zh: 把可以說是數碼寶貝心臟的數碼核心裝在頭上，使其猛烈燃燒的火焰型數碼寶貝。一旦在頭上燃燒的數碼核心之火消失，蠟燭獸就會無法維持生命活動。也有一個說法是或許頭上的火焰才是本體，身體的部分可能是替身。以火焰型數碼寶貝來說，蠟燭獸的個性很溫順，不會主動危害周遭的事物。必殺技是吐出小型火球的「篝火」。

description.en: A Crustacean Digimon that dramatically increased its combat ability by attaching metal data dissolved into the Net Ocean to its body. Crabmon attacks with a giant blade on its left pincer and the powerful grip of its right pincer. For defense, it relies on its thorny shell to damage attackers, and is utterly self-confident in battle. Its weak points are its joints and its underbelly, but since it is fully aware of these weaknesses, it rarely leaves them exposed. It enjoys trapping its opponents, and is something of a prankster. Its special move is Scissors Execution, by which it goes for its adversary’s throat with its sharp left pincer.
description.zh: 將融入網路之海的金屬資料附著於體表，藉此大幅提升戰鬥能力的甲殼類型數碼寶貝。會以擁有巨大利鉗的左前肢與握力強勁的右前肢進行攻擊，當對手發動攻擊時，則以帶有棘刺的表皮傷害對手，藉此防禦。螃蟹獸認為自己相當擅長戰鬥，十分有自信。弱點是關節與腹部，不過螃蟹獸也知道這一點，因此很少露出破綻。螃蟹獸的個性調皮，喜歡設陷阱給對方跳。必殺技是以左前肢攻擊對手脖子的「巨剪處刑」。

description.en: A small Digimon resembling a bat. DemiDevimon serves as a familiar to higher-level Digimon like Devimon and Myotismon. Despite its low status, it is rumored to have been responsible for tempting Devimon, once an Angel Digimon, to the dark side. What DemiDevimon lacks in attack power it makes up for in malicious cunning, and it’s always causing trouble somewhere. Fond of darkness and typically in the company of higher level Digimon, it’s rare to see DemiDevimon by itself. Its special move is Demi Darts, where it throws giant syringes at the enemy to drain their blood.
description.zh: 外表像是蝙蝠的小型使役魔數碼寶貝。雖然小惡魔獸是惡魔獸與吸血魔獸這類高階數碼寶貝的使役魔，但是煽動原本是天使系數碼寶貝的惡魔獸，將惡魔獸引進黑暗勢力的罪魁禍首據說就是小惡魔獸。攻擊力並不強，但是擅長動歪腦筋到處幹壞事。喜歡黑暗，經常與高階數碼寶貝待在一塊，很少有人看到小惡魔獸單獨行動。必殺技是擲出巨大注射器，取走對方血液的「小惡魔飛鏢」。

description.en: Dracmon is the Dark Area’s biggest prankster. It won’t hesitate to risk life and limb if that means successfully pulling off a prank. One time, for instance, it nearly died when it decided to draw doodles on the faces of all Four Sovereign Digimon (whether it succeeded or not is unclear). While technically a vampiric Digimon, rumor has it that lately it’s been so absorbed in pulling a prank on the Royal Knights that it’s forgotten all about drinking blood. It’s also said that anyone that looks directly into one of the Eye of Nightmares on its palms will be subject to its mind control. Furthermore, its Undead Fang attack involves biting into a foe with its fangs, much like a vampire.
description.zh: 黑暗區域中最喜歡惡作劇的數碼寶貝。為了惡作劇，就算會遇到或多或少的危險，也會毫不畏懼地挺身挑戰。據說德古獸曾因為嘗試在所有四聖獸的臉上塗鴉而差點死掉……(有沒有成功則不得而知)基本上算是吸血數碼寶貝，但最近似乎連吸血都忘了，正在計畫對皇家騎士惡作劇。位於雙手手掌的邪眼會發出「惡夢之眼」，據說直視到這招的對象會被德古獸支配心靈。另外似乎也有十分像個吸血鬼，用牙齒使出咬齧攻擊的「不死獠牙」這個招式。

description.en: The Cyborg Digimon Espimon will immediately start investigating any rumors or suspicious leads going around the Digital World the moment they reach its ears. It boldly goes to investigate the truth even in areas where dangerous Digimon may reside. Espimon can toggle its eyes to search mode to perform surveillance on objects that are many kilometers away. It can press the switch on its stomach to enable camouflage with its Divanish move, completely blending into its surroundings so it can avoid detection and do reconnaissance. Espimon's signature move is Mot Bomb, a self-propulsive automatically-detonating explosive that it can use as a decoy if the circumstances require it. It is said that the Crack Team tests its cracking ability by controlling Espimon, though the veracity of this rumor is unknown.
description.zh: 生化型數碼寶貝，每當得知數碼世界中的流言蜚語時，便會馬上前往調查。為了追查真相，即使是有危險的數碼寶貝棲息的地區，諜鼠獸也會果敢地潛入。當雙眼切換成搜索模式時，還可以清晰地辨識出數公里以外的物體。此外，按下腹部的按鈕能在全身施加光學迷彩效果的「潛行迷影」，可讓自己融入周圍環境，以便在不被發現的狀況下進行偵察。拿手招式是利用自動推進定時式炸彈的「土撥鼠炸彈」，來跟據情況攻擊敵人或做為誘餌使用。有謠言說，某個破解隊會透過操控諜鼠獸來測試自己的破解能力，但謠言的真實性不得而知。

description.en: Despite being covered in fur, this is a full-fledged Reptile Digimon. Gabumon is an extremely shy, timid creature, always gathering up the data Garurumon leaves behind and wearing it like a pelt. Since other Digimon are fearful of Garurumon’s pelt, this also serves to protect Gabumon. While wearing the pelt, Gabumon’s personality is completely reversed. Its special move is Blue Blaster.
description.zh: 披著一層毛皮，卻是貨真價實的爬蟲類型數碼寶貝。生性非常膽小又害羞，總是去收集加魯魯獸留下的數據資料做成毛皮披在身上。由於披著讓其他數碼寶貝畏懼的加魯魯獸毛皮，也產生了保護自身的功用。披上毛皮後性格會180度大轉變。必殺技是「爆炎火焰彈」。

description.en: A Mammal Digimon with huge, sharp claws. Gazimon is bipedal, which is unusual for  Mammal Digimon. It may be that using its front legs like arms was what allowed its claws to develop and caused it to learn to walk on its hind legs. Though not a large Digimon, it has an exceedingly wild temperament, and it never tries to get along with humans. The claws on its forelimbs are extremely effective for attacking, but are also surprisingly well-suited to digging holes. Due to Gazimon’s mischievous nature, it enjoys making pitfalls for other Digimon to fall into. Its special move is Electric Stun Blast, by which it breathes out with its poisonous breath.
description.zh: 長著銳利巨爪的哺乳類型數碼寶貝。在哺乳類型數碼寶貝之中是罕見的雙腳行走類型，可能是將前腳當成手來使用，於是前腳的爪子進化，才變成以雙腳行走。雖是小型數碼寶貝，個性卻相當粗暴，絕不親近人類。前腳的爪子在攻擊時相當好用，意外地也很適合用來挖洞。加支獸總是喜歡挖洞設陷阱，就是因為有著喜歡看其他數碼寶貝掉進洞裡的惡劣性格。必殺技是呼出氣態毒素的「麻痺毒氣」。

description.en: A vibrantly-colored Reptile Digimon that inhabits tropical rainforests throughout the Digital World. These bright colors act as camouflage allowing Gekkomon to blend in with its habitat, making spotting it difficult. The pads on its fingers and toes are capable of clinging to all kinds of surfaces, such as the trees or boulders on which it typically resides. Although personality varies from individual to individual, most are of an inquisitive and cheerful nature. Gekkomon's primary special move is Smash Beat, where it strikes foes with its freely-extendable tongue with a force that can even knock out Digimon stronger than itself if it lands a clean hit. It can also utilize its tongue to execute other creative attacks such as Break Throw, in which it grabs nearby objects with its tongue and hurls them at its opponent, or Swing Tackle, in which it uses its tongue to latch onto a nearby object before spinning itself around using centrifugal force to launch a body slam. When backed into a corner, Gekkomon has a tendency to cut off its own tail, which distracts foes while it escapes. Among members of the species, a shortened tail is regarded as a mark of cowardice, whereas a longer and unblemished tail is a sign of the owner's strength.
description.zh: 色彩繽紛的爬蟲類型數碼寶貝，棲息於數碼世界的熱帶雨林。月光壁虎獸的體色可在牠棲息的熱帶雨林中起到偽裝作用，雖然看似引人注目，但其實要發現牠絕非易事。牠的手指跟腳趾上有一種器官，有助於讓牠吸附在任何物體上，因此牠總是貼在樹木和岩石上生活，很少下到地面。每隻月光壁虎獸的個性不一，但大多都開朗活潑，充滿好奇心。牠能利用舌頭使出各式各樣的攻擊，必殺技是用伸縮自如的舌頭打擊敵人的「舔舐猛擊」，若能正中要害，甚至能擊倒比自己強大的數碼寶貝。此外，還有能用舌頭捲起附近的東西並丟向敵人的「投擲重擊」，以及能用舌頭纏住附近的樹木，利用離心力甩動自身，進而撞擊對手的「搖擺衝撞」。月光壁虎獸有斷尾求生的習性，一旦走投無路，牠就會自行斷尾引開對方的注意，再藉機逃跑。短尾通常是弱者的象徵，所以尾巴越長、損傷越少的月光壁虎獸在同族間就越受到推崇。

description.en: A Ghost Digimon often seen reveling in graveyards. Ghostmon is naturally shy and timid, preferring to stay out of sight, but it has a good heart and is happy to help anyone in need so long as it’s invisible.
description.zh: 經常被看到在墓地玩耍的幽靈型數碼寶貝。由於個性懦弱又容易害羞，不喜歡在他人面前露面，卻會變透明並悄悄地幫助正在煩惱的對象，是心地善良的數碼寶貝。

description.en: A Sea Animal Digimon with fins on its feet to paddle through water. Gizamon is more suited to life underwater than on land, using its fins and strong hind legs to swim quickly through subaquatic areas. On land, however, it bounces around like a frog. It acts cowardly on land, but displays its ferocious disposition once back in the water. Its special move Spiral Edge attacks foes with its sharp-edged dorsal fins.
description.zh: 手腳長有方便划水的鰭，水棲哺乳類型的數碼寶貝。比起陸地，更適合在水中生活。鰭和強韌的後腳讓基剎獸可以在水中迅速游動，但在陸地上就不擅長移動，會像青蛙一樣邊跳躍邊移動。在陸地上個性非常膽小，在水中則會發揮原有的凶猛個性。必殺技是以如同銳利刀刃般的背鰭襲擊對手的「螺旋飛刃」。

description.en: A Sea Beast Digimon covered in warm fur that can move on land. The short white fur that covers its body grows longer and turns brown as it ages. A busybody and a troublemaker, Gomamon loves to get involved in any situation. The streak of red fur running from its head down its back moves in accordance with its mood, bristling when Gomamon is angry. Its claws are sharp enough to cut through solid ice with ease, and anyone who underestimates Gomamon is in for a rude awakening. Its special move is Marching Fishes, by which Gomamon commands a loyal squad of small fish to attack.
description.zh: 變得可以在陸地上活動，身上蓋著一層保溫毛皮的海獸型數碼寶貝。身上的白色短體毛會隨著成長逐漸變長，據說更進一步成長時會變成棕色。個性是看到任何事物都想戲弄一下的調皮孩子類型。從頭部一路長到背脊的紅毛會隨著哥瑪獸的情緒產生起伏，生氣的時候會豎起來。哥瑪獸的爪子能輕易粉碎堅硬的冰，小看哥瑪獸的話可是會嚐到苦頭。必殺技是操縱小魚群屬下的「魚群大暴走」。

description.en: Gotsumon is an Ore Digimon with powerful defensive abilities, having armored itself using ore data from its surroundings. Spunky, mischievous, and ambitious as any young tough guy, it leads around groups of low-generation Digimon as it travels the system. It also has a selfish side, and can be a real handful when angered, rampaging like an erupting volcano. Depending on where and how it forms, the ore data it uses for armor may appear different, and it has the potential to Digivolve into a number of different forms. Gotsumon’s special move is Rock Fist, by which it shoots extremely hard ore from its head.
description.zh: 匯聚了礦場中的礦石數據，擁有強大防禦力的礦石型數碼寶貝。個性輕浮開朗、精力旺盛，平時像個孩子王一樣，帶著進化階段較低的數碼寶貝在系統內跑來跑去的。同時也有一點任性，一旦生氣就會像火山噴發一樣到處發脾氣，如同脫韁野馬。根據地點與條件的不同，礦石獸呈現的礦石數據會產生變化，蘊含著各種進化的可能性。必殺技是從頭頂發射超硬度礦石的「憤怒岩石」。

description.en: A Digimon resembling a young dinosaur. Although Guilmon is a Rookie Digimon, Guilmon possesses a carnivore’s brutality, and great potential as the fighting type Digimon it originally descended from. The mark on its chest is called the Digital Hazard, and is inscribed on any Digimon that could cause serious damage to computer data. Still, if used for the sake of peace, this ability could make it a guardian of the Digital World. It can use its signature move Rock Breaker to destroy even stone with its tenacious front claws. With its special move Fire Ball, it spits a powerful ball of flame from its mouth.
description.zh: 看起來還有點稚氣，長得像是恐龍的數碼寶貝。雖然還只是成長期，但身為「戰鬥種」的潛能極高，潛藏著肉食動物般的凶殘特質。而「戰鬥種」是數碼寶貝與生俱來的屬性。畫在腹部上的標誌被稱為「數碼危機」，其中刻著可能會對電腦數據帶來嚴重威脅的東西。不過，如果能善用這份力量，也有可能變成數碼世界的守護者。擅長的招式是以強勁的前爪發動攻擊，威力甚至能破壞岩石的「破岩擊」。必殺技是吐出強力火焰彈的「火焰彈」。

description.en: Hagurumon is a mutant Machine Digimon with a main body resembling a large gear. It has countless other gears built into its body, all of which are constantly spinning. If even one gear is removed, all of its other gears will stop turning and Hagurumon will cease functioning. Hagurumon has an ability that allows it to infect others with a virus so it can control them. For this reason, malicious Digimon often make use of Hagurumon. Since Hagurumon has no sense of self, though, it has no way of knowing it is being used for evil. Its special move is Cog Crusher, by which it implants a black gear loaded with a computer virus into its opponent’s body, causing them to go berserk.
description.zh: 外表像是齒輪的變種機械型數碼寶貝。體內也是由無數齒輪組成，而且齒輪一直都在運轉。因此只要拔掉一顆齒輪，全身上下的齒輪就會停止運作，無法維持齒輪獸的生命。齒輪獸擁有特殊能力，能夠將電腦病毒傳進對手體內，使對手完全受到自己操控，而這項能力受到了兇惡數碼寶貝的利用。不過，齒輪獸自己並沒有辦法思考，因此無法理解自己受到了利用。必殺技是將含有電腦病毒的黑色齒輪嵌入對方體內，讓對方失控的「黑暗齒輪」。

description.en: A calm, collected and extremely courteous Bird Digimon. Just like Veemon, it is a descendant of a unique species that prospered in ancient times, and can borrow the power of the Digi-Eggs for armored pseudo-Digivolution. Hawkmon’s signature move Pecking Beak unleashes violent beak attacks like a woodpecker. It uses its special move Feather Slash to throw the feather ornament on its head like a boomerang.
description.zh: 不論面對什麼事都沉著冷靜，十分有禮貌的鳥型數碼寶貝。與V仔獸一樣，是曾經興盛於古代的特殊種族末裔，能夠藉著「數碼裝甲」的力量擬似進化成裝甲體。擅長的招式是像啄木鳥般用喙使出激烈的啄擊，名稱為「喙啄」。必殺技是將頭部的羽飾當作回力鏢使用的「羽毛回力鏢」。

description.en: Keramon is a Rookie Digimon that Digivolved from Tsumemon. Now that its body has grown larger and its mouth is bigger, it can devour more data. Keramon is capable of consuming more than 100 megabytes per second, and most data is destroyed the instant Keramon accesses it. Extremely playful by nature, it thinks of its destructive acts as a kind of game. Its special move is Crazy Giggle, by which it unleashes a highly destructive beam of light from its mouth as it laughs... laughs?
description.zh: 妖爪獸進化而成的成長期數碼寶貝。體型有所成長，那巨大的嘴巴能夠吞下比妖爪獸更多的數據量。由於哈哈獸一秒鐘能夠侵蝕100MB以上的數據，所以當對方被哈哈獸侵蝕的同時，數據就會被破壞掉。個性相當開朗，認為破壞數據是一種遊戲。必殺技是一邊大笑(？)一邊從嘴裡吐出破壞力驚人的光彈「瘋狂大笑」。

description.en: An Insectoid Digimon of small stature but incredible strength. KoKabuterimon has large horns and forelimbs, and is feared by those around it, but it actually has a gentle disposition and dislikes conflict. That being said, it is rather powerful, having apparently lifted Tortomon up during the experimentation of a certain research institution. KoKabuterimon uses its special move Scoop Smash to scoop up and flick away foes with its vaunted horns, or Beetle Lariat to lunge with its large forelimbs.
description.zh: 身形嬌小，但相當有力氣的昆蟲型數碼寶貝。有著巨大的角和前腳，雖然受到周遭懼怕，其實有著不喜鬥爭的溫和個性。但小比多獸的力量相當強，據說在某研究機關的實驗中，曾經舉起過陸龜獸。必殺技是用其自豪的角鏟起敵人並彈飛的「掘殺碎擊」，以及用巨大的前腳施展的「甲蟲金臂勾」。

description.en: An extremely rare insect Machine Digimon that was recently discovered. No insect Machine Digimon had been discovered up to this point;  its mere existence not even considered a possibility. Kokuwamon’s stun gun-shaped head and arms can discharge 1 megavolts of electricity when it senses danger, so none can approach without caution. Even so, it lacks any aggression, having a docile nature that causes it to seek peace instead. Kokuwamon obtains nourishment from electricity, and recharges itself with the two limbs on its midsection. It uses its special move Mini Scissor Claw to electrify its pincers and slice through even the sturdiest objects.
description.zh: 最新發現，相當罕見的昆蟲系機械型數碼寶貝。以前沒有人發現過昆蟲系機械型數碼寶貝，而且也沒有人想過會有這種數碼寶貝存在。小古加獸的頭部與雙手長得像電擊槍，一察覺危險便會釋放出一百萬伏特的電力，最好別輕易靠近。不過小古加獸並不具有攻擊性，而是追求和平的老實性格。小古加獸的營養來源是電，並會用中間兩隻手來充電。必殺技是透過雙手夾鉗放電的「迷你剪刀臂」，這一招甚至能撕裂堅硬物體。

description.en: A Vegetation Digimon resembling a flower bud. Lalamon drifts through the sky by spinning the leaves on its head, and despite its lack of expression, it has a great deal of charm. Its special move Seed Blast involves shooting hard seeds from its mouth with a surprising degree of accuracy. It also has Lala Screw, where it spins its leaves as fast as it can to slam into an enemy, and Sing a Song, by which it lulls opponents to sleep with a relaxing tune.
description.zh: 外表如同花苞的植物型數碼寶貝。會一邊旋轉頭部的葉片一邊輕飄飄地飛行，面無表情卻很可愛。必殺技是從嘴巴射出堅硬樹果的「堅果射擊」。命中目標的準確度出乎意料地高。另外，還有盡可能地旋轉葉子，再朝著敵人突擊的「拉拉迴旋」，以及用聽來十分舒適的歌曲讓敵人睡著的「吟唱歌謠」。

description.en: Ludomon is one of the Legend-Arms that can transform its body into a weapon. Ludomon is the only Digimon among the Legend-Arms who transforms into a shield. Tough iron shields don its head and arms, enabling it to protect itself against attacks from any direction. As a Digimon focused on defense, records show incidents of Ludomon protecting areas targeted by the D-Brigade. With the special move Wall Rake, it wields the titular devices on its arms for both offensive and defensive purposes. Moreover, Ludomon demonstrates the full potential of its defense while in shield form.
description.zh: 「Legend-Arms」之一，能夠將自身變為武器。「Legend-Arms」中唯一能把自己變成盾的數碼寶貝。頭部和兩手持有堅硬的鋼鐵盾牌，不管受到來自何方的攻擊，都能保護自己。是以防衛為目的的數碼寶貝，有紀錄顯示路德獸成功守下了遭到「D-旅團」攻擊的地區。

description.en: A small Vegetation Digimon in the shape of a poisonous mushroom. Small but potent poisonous mushroom bombs growing from Mushroomon’s body cause all kinds of afflictions. Anyone hit by one of these bombs could start laughing uncontrollably, have their body go numb, lose their memories, and more. Mushroomon is extremely ill-tempered and loves to pick on the weak, but also has a shy side, always hiding half of its face. Its special move Fungus Crusher scatters a spread of mini-mushroom bombs.
description.zh: 長得像是毒菇的小型植物數碼寶貝。蘑菇獸的身上長有毒性極強的小型蘑菇炸彈，能夠引發各種症狀。如果被這種蘑菇炸彈打中，有可能會笑到停不下來，或是身體麻痺、記憶全部消失等等，出現各式各樣的症狀。蘑菇獸相當壞心眼，喜歡欺負弱小，但是也有著害羞的一面，經常只露出半張臉。必殺技是將所有小型蘑菇炸彈一次丟出的「劇毒超蘑菇」。

description.en: A larva Digimon whose epidermis has yet to solidify due to living underwater. Otamamon swims through swamps and rivers upstream of the Net Ocean with its large tail, occasionally clambering onto rocks with its developed forelimbs to do vocal exercises. Unlike those of an average organism, its hind legs are almost completely undeveloped, acting as rudders in place of its propulsive tail. This Digimon is valuable due to the fact that it’s future Digivolution is clearly indicated for a Rookie, but it is extremely prone to mutation, so caution is warranted when raising it. Otamamon uses its special move Lullaby Bubble to send opponents into an eternal slumber.
description.zh: 由於選擇在水裡生活，表皮還沒有完全固化的幼體數碼寶貝。會以巨大的尾巴游在網路之海上游的沼澤與河川，偶爾會以發達的前肢爬上岩石，練習發聲。幾乎沒有發育的後肢則代替得到推進力的尾巴，負責發揮舵的功用，這和一般的生物相反。是在成長期時能讓人先預測到其明顯進化的寶貴存在，但發生突然變異的可能性也相當大，在培育時需要多加留意。必殺技是讓對手陷入永恆沉眠的「睡之泡」。

description.en: A Vegetation Digimon with a tropical flower growing on its head. Though it Digivolved from Tanemon in a reptilian fashion, it’s a rare type of Digimon classified as a Vegetation Digimon based on its appearance and characteristics. During the day, Palmon opens its flower and leaf-like appendages to enable photosynthesis. Its root-like feet are usually buried in the ground absorbing nutrients, but it can also use them to walk. The flower on Palmon’s head gives off a sweet scent when it’s happy or enjoying itself and a foul stench when it’s angry or feels threatened. The latter is so bad it can send even larger Digimon running. Palmon’s special move is Poison Ivy, by which it wraps its foe in ivy laced with a strong poison. Anything hit by this attack is paralyzed.
description.zh: 頭上盛開著熱帶花朵的植物型數碼寶貝。雖然是從種子獸朝爬蟲類進化，卻因為外表和特性而被歸類為植物型的稀有類型。白天會伸展花葉般的手臂進行光合作用。平時會像植物根部一樣把腳埋進土壤中吸取養分，但也能夠步行。頭上的花在開心快樂時會散發甘甜香氣，憤怒或察覺到危險時則會散發出連大型數碼寶貝都會落荒而逃的惡臭。必殺技是以帶有強烈毒性的蔓藤纏住敵人的「毒蔓藤」。受到此攻擊後會使身體麻痺。

description.en: A Mammal Digimon known for its large ears. Patamon can use these to fly, but since it can only do so at a little over 0.5 mph, its walking speed is said to be considerably faster. Even so, watching it struggle to fly is an endearing sight, making it very popular (although Patamon itself doesn’t appreciate this). Patamon is extremely obedient and very good about doing what it’s told. It can also use its Hidden Power without a Holy Ring—a sign that it’s descended from an Ancient species of Digimon. Patamon has two special moves: Air Shot, by which it takes a deep breath and then releases a powerful blast of air, and Wing Slap, by which it attacks its foe with its two large ears.
description.zh: 特徵是大耳朵的哺乳類型數碼寶貝。雖然能用這對大翅膀飛上天，但時速僅能達到一公里，因此被說用走的絕對比較快。然而巴達獸拚命飛行的模樣十分可愛，因此非常受歡迎（巴達獸自己似乎無法接受）。巴達獸個性純樸，會乖乖遵守受到告知的事。此外，巴達獸似乎繼承了古代種數碼寶貝的遺傳因子，即使身上沒有神聖之環，也能發揮潛藏的神聖力量。必殺技是吸入空氣後再一口氣吐出空氣彈的「空氣炮」，以及用兩片大耳拍打敵人的「羽翼打擊」。

description.en: A Beast Man Digimon with the appearance of a golden fox. Renamon’s relationship to humans is clearly demonstrated, and its In-Training form can Digivolve into a Digimon of high intelligence if it is raised properly. Calm and collected at all times, it trains in order to keep its cool in any situation. Renamon’s tall, slender form stands out among Rookie Digimon, and it prefers the speed of its many techniques over power when it comes to fighting the enemy. Its signature move Kohenkyo is a transformation technique that copies the opponent’s appearance and overwrites its texture. Its special move Diamond Storm hurls razor-sharp wood chips at the enemy.
description.zh: 外表如金色狐狸的獸人型數碼寶貝。據說妖狐獸這種數碼寶貝會如實展現與人類之間的關係，根據幼年期培養方式的不同，有可能進化成特別聰明的妖狐獸。經過訓練，總是表現得鎮定自若，無論面對什麼狀況都能保持冷靜。與其他的成長期數碼寶貝相比，那纖瘦修長的身形十分出眾。比起靠力量決勝，更擅於以敏捷的身手變化出豐富的戰術，將敵人玩弄於手掌心。擅長的招式是複製對手的樣貌，並替換到自己身上的偽裝術「狐變虛」。必殺技是將銳利的樹葉擲向敵人的「狐葉楔」。

description.en: Salamon is a young sacred-species Digimon with distinctive floppy ears. Since it’s still a child, it isn’t able to make full use of its holy powers, and has yet to realize its destiny. As a result, its nature is fundamentally unstable, and it is capable of becoming either good or evil. There will likely come a day, however, when Salamon will awaken to its destiny as one of the Virus Busters. After all, it was born a sacred-species Digimon. Salamon is also an experimental Digimon created by Digimon researchers, and since it was modeled after a human pet, it looks a great deal like a real animal. Its special move Puppy Howl involves letting out a supersonic screech that can paralyze foes.
description.zh: 神聖系數碼寶貝的幼體，特徵是有著下垂的耳朵。由於還很幼小，無法發揮神聖力量，也不清楚自己的使命。因此性質不定，有可能加入善的一方，也有可能與惡為伍。不過身為神聖系數碼寶貝的小狗獸，想必總有一天會認知到自己的使命是成為「病毒剋星」。另外，小狗獸是由數碼寶貝研究者所製造的實驗性數碼寶貝，製造時是參考人類身邊的寵物，因此樣貌與現實世界中的動物十分相似。必殺技「小狗怒吼」是以超高音的叫聲讓對手動彈不得的招式。

description.en: A Mollusk Digimon living in the shallows of the Net Ocean. Sangomon has a gentle and cheerful disposition that allows it to form connections with many other species. It uses Shellmon’s back as a bed, and Crabmon has been witnessed trimming the coral protruding from its head. When attacked by an invader, Sangomon uses Refuge Mist, a tear-inducing poisonous mist scattered from its coral, to make its escape. When this fails, it fights back with Coral Pressure, shooting high-pressure water from the ends of its arms.
description.zh: 生活在網路之海淺水處的軟體型數碼寶貝。由於個性和善又開朗，經常與其他種族互動。曾經有人目擊到珊瑚獸把貝殼獸的背當作睡床，以及頭上的珊瑚長得太長而受到螃蟹獸修剪的模樣。

description.en: A rare species of mechanical Machine Digimon.. Some researchers believe Solarmon to be a mutation of Hagurumon, but the truth of the matter remains a mystery. Because its DigiCore generates heat, its body is hot enough to cause burns. Solarmon uses its special move Shiny Ring to throw heat-emitting gears that scorch the enemy.
description.zh: 似乎是機械系數碼寶貝中屬於珍奇品種的機械型數碼寶貝。研究者之間認為太陽獸可能是突然變異的齒輪獸，但是真相不明。由於太陽獸的「電腦核」維持發熱狀態，身體部分熱到會令人灼傷。必殺技是投擲高溫齒輪燒焦敵人的「閃光環」。

description.en: A Digimon shaped like a clam and surrounded by a sturdy shell. Its highly developed shell protects what looks like an In-Training slime. This deceptive guy uses its face to lure enemies in before attacking them. Syakomon also boasts a high defense when its shell is closed, repelling small attacks with ease. Its special move Black Pearl Blast fires jadeite formed in its body at the enemy, and Water Pressure slams a super-high pressure water current at its foes.
description.zh: 以硬殼包住身體，外型像是雙殼貝的數碼寶貝。由於著重於外殼的成長，因此內部構造是幼年期般的軟泥狀。蝦蛄獸會利用可愛的表情吸引對手，等對手靠近便發動攻擊，個性十分狡猾。另外，蝦蛄獸在殼閉上的狀態下有相當高的防禦力，能夠輕易地反彈輕度的攻擊。必殺技是以體內形成的硬玉射擊對手的「黑珍珠」，還有利用超高壓水流衝撞敵人的「水流螺旋」。

description.en: The prototypical Insectoid Digimon, Tentomon has a hard carapace but a low level of aggression. Tentomon has one claw on each of its forelegs, and four claws on its middle and hind legs. Its middle legs in particular are highly dexterous, similar to human hands. Though other Insectoid Digimon of Tentomon’s Digivolution level are consumed by a strong fighting spirit, Tentomon retains a love and appreciation for nature at this stage. Exhibiting a fondness for relaxation, Tentomon will stop to smell flowers and nap in the shade of trees. Even so, it does have the special move Super Shocker, which involves using its wings to shoot out amplified bolts of static electricity.
description.zh: 雖然擁有堅硬的甲殼，但攻擊性還很低的昆蟲型數碼寶貝原始型。前肢有一根硬爪，中肢和後肢則是有四根硬爪，尤其是中肢能像人類的手一樣靈活地抓取物體。對其他進化型的昆蟲型數碼寶貝只懷有鬥爭意識，但甲蟲獸在這個時期似乎還留有親近大自然的感情，能觀察到甲蟲獸輕嗅花香、在樹蔭下睡午覺的悠哉生態。姑且擁有的必殺技是以翅膀增加靜電後擊出的「小型閃電」。

description.en: An enigmatic Digimon with a massive horn growing from its head. While Terriermon’s composition is enough to deem it a Beast Digimon, the form it takes after Digivolving is still unknown. Rumor has it that it is sometimes born with a twin. Terriermon’s extreme cuteness and calm behavior do not give the impression that this Digimon is of the Combat Species. Still, the power it exhibits in battle belies its appearance. It uses its signature move Terrier Tornado to spin both of its ears like a propeller, creating a small tornado. With the special move Blazing Fire, it spits a shot of super-heated air. It is also said to have a powerful team attack called Double Typhoon that it unleashes together with its twin, Lopmon.
description.zh: 頭部長了一支角，充滿謎團的數碼寶貝。以體格構造來說能分類為獸系數碼寶貝，至今卻仍無法明瞭大耳獸經歷了什麼樣的進化型態。此外，還有大耳獸會在罕見的情況下以雙胞胎形式誕生的傳聞。算是非常可愛的數碼寶貝，從那悠哉的舉止很難切身體會大耳獸身為數碼寶貝的「戰鬥種族」特性，但發生戰鬥時就會發揮出不可貌相的力量。擅長的招式是讓兩隻耳朵轉得像螺旋槳，造成小規模龍捲風的「小型龍捲風」。必殺技是吐出高溫熱氣彈的「爆裂爆炎」。另外，大耳獸可以和普遍視為大耳獸雙胞胎的黑大耳獸一起使出合體招式「雙重颱風」，據說這招也擁有十分強大的威力。

description.en: Veemon is a new type of Digimon only recently discovered. It is a surviving member of a species that once thrived in the dawn of the Digital World. This allows it to use Digi-Eggs to perform a type of pseudo-Digivolution known as Armor Digivolution. Of all its peers, Veemon is among the best Combat Species. It possesses a hidden power, and uses Armor Digivolution to bring out its explosive abilities. Though a troublemaker and a prankster by nature, Veemon also has a strong sense of justice. Veemon uses its signature move Boom Boom Punch to spin both arms and strike its opponent. It uses its special move Veemon Headbutt to knock out foes with a powerful headbutt.
description.zh: 新發現的新種數碼寶貝。數碼世界創世紀時期一度興盛的種族倖存的後裔，可使用數碼裝甲進行「擬似進化」的「裝甲進化」。當中V仔獸屬於優秀的戰鬥種族，擁有潛藏的力量，透過裝甲進化能發揮出爆炸性的能力。個性淘氣又愛惡作劇，但也有正義感強烈的一面。擅長的招式是轉動雙臂來毆打敵人的「車輪拳」。必殺技是以猛烈頭擊來打倒敵人的「V仔頭槌」。

description.en: A Larva Digimon with a timid, cowardly personality. Wormmon is a descendant of the same ancient species as Veemon, so it can perform a special Armor Digivolution. Exceedingly weak on its own, Wormmon stands little chance against larger Digimon. But with the power of the Digi-Eggs, it can Armor Digivolve and display incredible power. Like a larva maturing into an adult, Wormmon will one day Digivolve into a Champion of great power. This Digimon is the very embodiment of future potential. It uses its special move Sticky Net to shoot viscous webs that blind the enemy, or Silk Thread to shoot a thin thread as sharp and pointy as a needle tip.
description.zh: 個性懦弱又膽小的幼蟲型數碼寶貝。和V仔獸等數碼寶貝同樣是古代種族的後裔，雖然可以進行特殊的裝甲進化，但單一的蟲蟲獸弱小無力，無法戰勝大型數碼寶貝。不過，只要靠著數碼裝甲的力量實行裝甲進化，就能發揮出令人難以置信的力量。據說就如同脆弱的幼蟲成長為堅強的成蟲一般，蟲蟲獸有一天也會進化為威力十足的成熟期數碼寶貝，可以說是未來充滿著可能性的數碼寶貝。必殺技是吐出高黏力的網狀蛛絲，阻礙對手行動的「粘性羅網」，還有吐出細如蠶絲但前端像針一樣尖銳的「絹絲線」。

description.en: Zubamon is one of the Legend-Arms that can transform its body into a weapon. The fabled Legend-Arms are said to be capable of either saving the world in the hands of an angel, or destroying it in the hands of a devil. Zubamon possesses the data of the Twentiest, and often shouts “I am the Twentiest!” without knowing what that means. It dislikes anything warped or twisted, and is in constant pursuit of its ideal of sharpness. In battle and in jest, it’s always trying to look sharp, and days when it succeeds put it in a good mood. Though it has its Twenty Dive attack that involves rushing headlong at an enemy, Zubamon’s true strength lies in its weapon form.
description.zh: 「Legend-Arms」之一，能夠將自身變為武器。傳說Legend-Arms「由天使掌控便能拯救世界，受惡魔操縱即會毀滅世界」。茲巴獸擁有「最二十」的數據，經常把「我就是最二十！」這句莫名其妙的話掛在嘴邊。看不慣不公不義的事情，一心追求俐落感。能夠暢快地戰鬥和說笑話的時候心情會很好。雖然有「二十連俯衝」這個用頭衝撞敵人的招式，但是茲巴獸要變成武器才能發揮實力。

description.en: A Kokatorimon-species Digimon with developed legs that compensate for its inability to fly. Akatorimon consumes even more energy than one might expect to move its large body around, making it unsuited to intense battles. It uses its special move Chicken Red Eyes to glare at its foe with red eyes, petrifying and shattering them.
description.zh: 因無法飛行而促使腳部發達的巨雞獸種數碼寶貝。活動巨大身軀時消耗的能量比表面上看起來更多，因此似乎不擅長激烈的戰鬥。必殺技是透過紅眼凝視敵人，將其石化並破壞的「傷痕紅眼」。

description.en: An Angel Digimon with six shining wings and a body clad in divine white cloth. This being of absolute goodness is said to bring happiness, and Angemon remains utterly composed in the face of evil, attacking relentlessly until its foe is annihilated. Legend has it that Angemon has often descended at the head of a host of other Digimon of the same species when the Digital World was in crisis. It’s also said that Devimon, who was won over to the Dark Side, was originally of the same species. Angemon’s special move is Heaven’s Knuckle, by which it pummels its foe with shining fists of gold.
description.zh: 擁有六片燦爛奪目的翅膀，身穿神聖白衣的天使數碼寶貝。天使獸是絕對善良的存在，雖被稱為能帶來幸福的數碼寶貝，但對邪惡非常冷酷，在徹底消滅對手之前不會停止攻擊。據傳在數碼世界幾度面臨危機時，天使獸都曾率領同種的數碼寶貝降臨，被拉入黑暗勢力的惡魔獸原本也屬於同種族。必殺技是以閃耀著黃金光輝的拳頭攻擊對手的「天堂之拳」。

description.en: An Armored Dragon Digimon completely covered in hardened skin. Tough protuberances cover it all over, giving its charge attack incredible destructive power. Although as an herbivore it lacks ferocity, Ankylomon displays a brave nature nonetheless. Its special move Megaton Press sends it surprisingly high into the sky, after which it slams its massive body down onto the enemy. It uses Tail Hammer to ferociously beat the enemy with the iron ball on the tip of its tail. Any Digimon hit by this technique has its entire skeleton (or wireframe) utterly obliterated.
description.zh: 全身覆蓋著硬化表皮的鎧龍型數碼寶貝。戰甲獸的表皮不只是單純硬化，各處還長出了質地堅硬的突起物，因此戰甲獸的衝擊破壞力一流。戰甲獸基本上是草食系的數碼寶貝，因此並不兇猛，但性格十分勇敢，一點都不膽小。必殺技是跳向高空然後用龐大的身體壓制敵人的「百萬噸重壓」，令人意想不到。另外還有使用尾巴上的鐵球重擊敵人的「尾巴錘擊」。被這一招擊中的話，全身的骨骼（線框）會被砸得粉碎。

description.en: A Giant Bird Digimon with two massive horns growing from its head. Known as the “Great Eagle of the Desert,” Aquilamon flies through the skies at Mach speed, and can seek out distant enemies with its keen eyesight. The horns on its head are immensely powerful when it glides down and rams into enemies. Many Bird Digimon are brutal, but Aquilamon respects decorum and obeys the orders of the master it has pledged allegiance to without fail. It uses its special move Glide Horn to charge enemies from the heavens, or Blast Laser to fire ring-shaped beams with a thunderous roar.
description.zh: 頭部長出了兩支巨角的巨鳥型數碼寶貝。被稱為「沙漠的巨鵰」，能以音速飛行於空中，並且擁有可從遠方確認敵人位置的眼力。從遠方的空中滑行，筆直地衝向敵人時，亞古拉獸頭上的角能發揮出極大的威力。雖然鳥系數碼寶貝大多脾氣粗暴，但亞古拉獸十分重視禮節，只要發誓效忠便決不違抗主人的命令。必殺技是從空中衝向敵人的「碎裂角」，還有在發出雷鳴般的叫聲同時發射環狀光線的「爆風雷射」。

description.en: A Ghost Digimon with a cloth over its body. Bakemon is a wicked being born from the darkness, and computers possessed by it are said to have their systems destroyed in an instant. What’s inside that cloth is a matter of mystery, and the shadow cast under its true form is thought by some to be a black hole. Bakemon lacks attack power, and thus doesn’t like attacking directly. Its special move Hell’s Hand casts a powerful curse. Anyone lacking a powerful mind will die in seconds when cursed by Death Charm.
description.zh: 頭上披著布遮住全身的幽靈數碼寶貝。猛鬼獸是從黑暗誕生的邪惡存在，據說電腦遭其附身後系統會在一瞬間受到破壞。布底下完全是一團謎，也有一種說法是猛鬼獸本體底下的影子部分是黑洞。猛鬼獸由於戰鬥力不高，不喜歡直接攻擊。必殺技「地獄之手」能將抓住的敵人拖進地獄。此外，施加強力詛咒的「死亡魅惑」則是可讓沒有強韌精神的對手在幾秒內喪命。

description.en: A Giant Bird Digimon wreathed in blazing flames. Like Meramon, Birdramon is a Digimon formed from the Internet’s defensive Firewall. Birdramon flies through the sky using its massive wings. Despite not having any warlike qualities, Birdramon will launch a frenzied counterattack in the face of enemy assaults. Birdramon’s special move is Meteor Wing, by which it flaps its wings to send feathers shooting down like meteors.
description.zh: 身上纏繞著熊熊火焰的巨鳥型數碼寶貝。和火焰獸相同，是誕生自網路防禦牆「防火牆」的數碼寶貝。會展開巨大的翅膀在天空中翱翔。個性絕非好戰，但面對來襲的敵人會狂暴地展開反擊。必殺技是振翅讓羽毛如流星般飛刺出去的「隕石巨翼」。

description.en: A guardian of time that governs computer timers. Clockmon manages all “time” and “space” on computers and networks, and can move time forward and backward freely between the years 1900 and 1999. It always maintains a neutral stance due to this incredibly dangerous and terrifying ability, refusing to take part in conflict between Vaccine and Virus Digimon. Many think that if Clockmon were to lean towards either side of this equilibrium, the Digital World itself would collapse. It uses its special move Chrono Breaker to destroy the very “time” flowing in the enemy’s body. Digimon whose time is stopped by this technique can never recover.
description.zh: 掌管電腦計時器的時間守護者。負責管理電腦及網路上所有的「時間」與「空間」，如果是在1900年至1999年之間，還能夠任意使時間前進或後退。由於擁有十分危險又可怕的能力，總是保持著中立立場，不會介入疫苗種與病毒種之間的紛爭。也因為如此，據說這種均衡要是傾向其中一方，數碼世界就會崩潰。必殺技「超時空破碎」可以破壞流淌在敵人身上的「時間」。被這個技能停止「時間」的數碼寶貝便無法再恢復了。

description.en: An Evil Dragon Digimon feared as the “Many-Eyed Demon.” A demonic beast summoned from the Dark Area by the messenger of darkness Devimon, no Digimon comes close to this creature in terms of sheer wickedness. Devidramon has abnormally developed limbs for a Dramon-species Digimon. It rakes at opponents with elongated arms, and flits about the darkness with stout legs and wings. Evil incarnate, not an ounce of mercy resides in this creature’s heart. Its four eyes burn a deep crimson; those caught in Devidramon’s gaze seize up, allowing it to hew them to pieces without resistance. Furthermore, the tip of its tail unfurls into talons that can skewer its opponent. The wicked feelings of hackers who exploit computer networks for their own selfish desires likely gave birth to this Digimon. Devidramon uses its special move Crimson Claw to cleave its foe with giant claws, tormenting them viciously.
description.zh: 被稱為「複眼惡魔」，受到懼怕的邪龍數碼寶貝。是黑暗使者惡魔獸從黑暗區域召喚而來的魔獸，沒有其他的數碼寶貝能比邪龍獸更加邪惡。雖是龍獸系的數碼寶貝，手腳卻異常發達，會伸出長長的雙臂撕裂對手，用強韌的雙腳與翅膀飛竄於黑暗之中。其個性即是邪惡的化身，並未具有慈悲之心。一旦被那四隻熊熊燃燒的深紅色眼睛瞪視，對手的身體就會動彈不得，毫無抵抗地遭到碎屍萬段。此外，其尾巴末端在展開後會變成鉤爪狀，能夠穿刺對手。這隻數碼寶貝之所以會誕生，或許是源自於駭客們為了一己之私而濫用電腦網路的邪惡情感。必殺技是以巨大的爪子將對手砍成碎片，用以血祭的「緋紅之爪」。

description.en: A Dark Angel Digimon clothed in jet black garb. Devimon was once a lustrous Digimon of the Angemon species, but it became a Dark Angel when it fell into the warped space of the Digital World known as the Dark Area. The prominent Mark of Evil on its chest is proof of this. Though it has a cunning and malevolent personality, Devimon is also extremely intelligent. It is said that any who stare into its glowing red eyes fall victim to its mind control, and are dominated by Devimon. Its special move is Death Claw, by which it pierces its opponent with its two extendable arms.
description.zh: 全身包裹著漆黑衣裳的墮天使型數碼寶貝。原本是光輝閃耀的天使獸系數碼寶貝，卻因為墜入數碼世界扭曲空間之中的黑暗區域，因此變成了墮天使。作為墮落證明的邪惡標誌大大地浮現在胸前。個性狡猾凶惡，但也是具有出眾智力的數碼寶貝。據說被那閃耀著深紅光芒的雙眼盯上就會遭到精神控制，受到惡魔獸的支配。必殺技「死亡之爪」是將伸縮自如的雙手伸長，貫穿對手的身體。

description.en: An Armor Insectoid Digimon that has Digivolved with the Digi-Egg of Knowledge. The Digi-Egg of Knowledge has the attribute of earth, allowing those who equip it to control the ground. As its unique form suggests, Digmon never loses against other Digimon in underground combat. Digmon uses its signature move Big Crack to strike the earth with rotating drills and cause a fissure to form. It uses its special move Gold Rush to unleash a concentrated attack with the drills rotating at high speeds on its nose and hands.
description.zh: 受到「知識裝甲」之力影響而進化的裝甲體昆蟲型數碼寶貝。「知識裝甲」具備「土」屬性，裝備此數碼裝甲的數碼寶貝能夠操控大地。從那奇特的外表可得知，鋼鑽獸在陸戰中所向披靡。擅長的招式是用旋轉的鑽頭攻擊地面，使地面裂開的「大爆裂」。必殺技是讓鼻尖與雙手的鑽頭高速旋轉，接著一同發出攻擊的「黃金衝擊」。

description.en: A cursed Digimon in the shape of a spider, whose entire body is infested with a computer virus. Although originally a spider type, Dokugumon was a gentle Digimon that behaved more in a typical Insect Digimon fashion. One day, however, it was caught in a powerful electromagnetic storm, and was infected with a computer virus lurking around the network. From that moment on, it became a lump of venom known as a computer virus, corroding everything with a simple touch. Dokugumon’s eight-legged mobility is worthy of special mention. Even if someone runs from it at full speed, this Digimon will be right on their heels, pursuing them until they tire themselves out. And when its foe sleeps peacefully, it will end them with a dreadful Venom Blast from its fiendish fangs.
description.zh: 全身都遭到電腦病毒寄生，樣貌有如蜘蛛，受詛咒的數碼寶貝。雖說蜘蛛獸原本就是蜘蛛型的外觀，但蜘蛛獸單純是隻平凡而個性沉穩的昆蟲系數碼寶貝，只是在某天被捲進強烈的電磁波暴風，因而受到流竄於網路的電腦病毒感染。在那之後，蜘蛛獸就成了名為電腦病毒的毒素聚合體，會腐蝕觸碰到的一切。另外，蜘蛛獸使用八隻腳的移動能力也十分值得一提。不管對方逃得再怎麼拼命，蜘蛛獸一定會緊跟在後，在對手筋疲力盡而停下腳步之前，都不會停止追蹤。等對手發出平靜的打呼聲時，蜘蛛獸會用凶惡的牙齒使出可怕的毒素攻擊「最強毒針」，解決掉敵人。

description.en: With a hard outer shell like a shrimp and huge pincers, Ebidramon is an outlier among the Dramon-species Digimon. Even so, those who underestimate it based on its looks are sure to fall prey to the powerful attacks of the species. Its special move is Twin Neptune, by which it attacks with its two pincers.
description.zh: 擁有像蝦子一樣的硬殼與巨鉗，在龍獸系數碼寶貝中屬於非主流的存在。要是被那外表欺騙，小看了龍蝦獸，便會敗在龍獸系數碼寶貝特有的攻擊力之下。必殺技是用雙鉗襲擊敵人的「海龍皇雙鉗」。

description.en: A Mythical Dragon Digimon that gained Veemon’s original power and Digivolved to Champion. ExVeemon is the pure breed of Veedramon, who is said to be a derivative species. Attacks with its developed arm and leg strength are capable of destroying a mountain of boulders without leaving a trace. It is feared for this destructive power, but in truth it has a strong sense of justice, and does not use its power recklessly. ExVeemon’s signature move Strong Crunch is an intense biting attack. It uses its special move Vee Laser to fire an energy beam from the X-shaped mark on its chest.
description.zh: V仔獸掌握原有的力量，進化而成的成熟期幻龍型數碼寶貝。V仔獸EX是V龍獸的原種，據說從V仔獸EX派生的支系之一便是V龍獸。據說V仔獸EX卓越的臂力和腿力所施展出的攻擊十分驚人，甚至連山一樣大的岩石都可以粉碎殆盡。其強大破壞力會令周遭心生畏懼，但V仔獸EX其實正義感很強，不會隨便使用那份力量。擅長的招式是強勁的牙咬攻擊「強烈噬咬」。必殺技是從胸前的X字紋樣發射出能量波的「X光線」。

description.en: An Armored Dragon Man Digimon that has Digivolved through the Digi-Egg of Courage. The Digi-Egg of Courage has the attribute of fire, allowing those who equip it to attack opposing Digimon with overwhelming power as their hand-to-hand fighting abilities increase to the intensity of raging flames. Flamedramon uses its signature move Flaming Fist to pummel its opponents with fists of flame. It uses its special move Fire Rocket to transform its entire body into a flaming rocket that obliterates its foes.
description.zh: 透過「勇氣裝甲」的力量進化而成的裝甲體龍人型數碼寶貝。「勇氣裝甲」具備「炎」屬性，裝備此數碼裝甲的數碼寶貝，其格鬥能力會如同熊熊烈焰般攀升，能夠以強烈力量攻擊敵方數碼寶貝。擅長的招式是以化為火焰的拳頭揮向敵人的「烈焰拳」。必殺技則是讓全身化為炎之火箭來粉碎敵人的「烈焰火箭」。

description.en: A Fire Dragon whose entire body is wreathed in fire. Flarerizamon is a hot-blooded Digimon with the power of a dragon and a heart that burns like fire. It creates the flames enveloping its body by igniting its high-temperature skin, and thanks to the incredible regenerative capabilities of this skin, it will continue to burn until it draws its final breath. The claws on both hands are superheated by roasting in its body’s flames, causing any foe struck by them to suffer damage from both lacerations and burns. It uses its signature move Flame Tower to form its body’s flames into a giant pillar that it shoots at the enemy. With Flame Hit, it rapidly shoots high-temperature flame bullets.
description.zh: 全身被火焰纏繞的火炎龍型數碼寶貝。同時擁有烈焰般火熱的心，以及龍的威力，是相當熱血的數碼寶貝。全身上下的火焰是由燃燒高溫皮膚所形成，不過火蜥蜴獸的皮膚擁有驚人的再生能力，因此能夠不斷燃燒直到死去為止。另外，火蜥蜴獸身上的火焰使得雙手的爪子變得非常燙，如果被抓到的話，會受到撕裂傷與燙傷的雙重傷害。擅長的招式是將全身的火焰化為巨柱投向敵人的「火焰塔」。必殺技是連續擊出高溫火焰彈的「烈焰打擊」。

description.en: A brutal Insectoid Digimon with massive wings. These wings allow Flymon to skirt through the air at ultrahigh speeds, creating sonic booms in its wake that rob unlucky victims of their hearing. Its body is protected by a tough carapace, and it pinches foes with its huge talons before killing them with the extra-potent venomous stinger on its tail. The Digivolution process of Insectoid Digimon is still unknown, but from its face, some have surmised that Flymon originally Digivolved from a Kunemon-type creature. It uses its special move Brown Stingers to shoot a stinger from its tail that completely paralyzes the Digimon it stabs, turning their body purple before ending their life. Incidentally, this nasty stinger can be regrown over and over again.
description.zh: 擁有不祥巨大翅膀的昆蟲型數碼寶貝。藉著那對巨大的翅膀，黃蜂獸能以超高速四處飛竄，並在飛行時造成聽起來像「嗡──」的巨大回授噪音，麻痺聽者的聽覺。身體受到堅硬的外殼所保護，能以碩大的鉤爪夾住敵人，再用尾部的超強力毒針使其死亡。昆蟲型數碼寶貝的進化過程仍未釐清，但從臉部的形狀來看，能推判黃蜂獸應是由古尼獸種進化而成。必殺技「致命毒針」會射出尾部毒針，據說被毒針刺到的數碼寶貝會全身麻痺，身體漸漸變成紫色，最後喪命。順帶一提，黃蜂獸的毒針會不斷地重新長出來，十分棘手。

description.en: An Ice-Snow Digimon whose body is covered in snow and ice crystals. In spite of its chilly appearance, Frigimon actually has a warm and gentle personality. This Digimon calms the hearts of those who observe it through sweet gestures and calm movements. Frigimon itself hates the idea of fighting, and is ill-suited to Digimon who enjoy combat—Meramon in particular. It unleashes its special move Sub-zero Ice Punch from its sizable frame.
description.zh: 冰雪數碼寶貝，全身覆蓋著雪與冰的結晶。性格與冰冷的外表相反，相當敦厚貼心，悠哉的動作與可愛的姿態看了令人放鬆。雪人獸並不喜歡戰鬥，也不擅長與喜歡戰鬥的數碼寶貝打交道，尤其是火焰獸。必殺技是以龐大的身體揮出的「絕對零度拳」。

description.en: An Armor Dark Beast Digimon that has Digivolved with the Digi-Egg of Light. Originally an Evil-species Digimon, Gargoylemon’s powers have been suppressed using restraints, and it sometimes serves as a familiar for Angel Digimon. It is said that should it ever be freed from its bindings, it would wield incredible power. Its special move is White Statue, by which it summons the statue of a giant demon to attack its foes.
description.zh: 受到「光明裝甲」之力影響而進化的裝甲體魔獸型數碼寶貝。原本是惡魔系數碼寶貝，後來力量受到了枷鎖抑制。天使型數碼寶貝有時會將石像鬼獸當成使役魔使喚。據說石像鬼獸若是從枷鎖的束縛中得到解放，就能夠發揮出驚人的力量。必殺技是召喚出巨大的惡魔半身像，襲向敵人的「白色雕像」。

description.en: A wolf-like Beast Digimon with a pale silver pelt. Garurumon’s fur is said to be as hard as Mithril, the legendary rare metal, and the blades that extend from its shoulders are so sharp they can sever anything they touch. With its physique honed in the frozen tundra and its intense instinct for conflict, Garurumon is feared by other Digimon for its predatory ferocity and agility. However, it is also remarkably intelligent, and steadfastly loyal to those it acknowledges as its leader. Its special move is Fox Fire, by which it breathes out an intense stream of blue flames.
description.zh: 全身覆蓋著藍色、銀白色的毛皮，外型如狼一般的獸型數碼寶貝。身上的毛如傳說中的稀有金屬「祕銀」般堅硬，從肩上伸出的刀刃相當銳利，能將接觸到的東西一刀兩斷。擁有在極寒地帶鍛鍊出的肌肉與強烈的戰鬥本能，像肉食動物一樣靈敏，能確實解決獵物，是其他數碼寶貝畏懼的存在。然而，加魯魯獸的智力高超，會忠實服從其認定為主人或領袖的對象。必殺技是從口中吐出高溫藍色火焰的「妖狐火焰」。

description.en: A Digimon brimming with curiosity that loves to pull pranks. Gatomon may be small, but it’s still a rare sacred-species Digimon whose appearance belies its true power. It wears its Holy Ring on its tail, proving that it is a sacred-species Digimon, although it will also lose some of its power if it ever loses this ring. Besides the Holy Ring, Gatomon also wears gloves with long, sharp claws copied from the data of SaberLeomon to protect itself. Gatomon’s special moves include Lightning Paw, by which it uses its claws to attack, and Cat’s Eye, which allows it to manipulate its opponent with a piercing glare. Those who meet its gaze will end up attacking themselves.
description.zh: 好奇心非常旺盛，喜愛惡作劇。雖然體型嬌小，但卻是很珍貴的神聖系數碼寶貝，擁有和外表不相稱的實力。尾巴上有著作為神聖系證明的神聖之環，但若卸下這個神聖之環，力量就會減弱，導致無法發揮原本的實力。迪路獸為了保護自己，裝備著複製黃金劍獅獸的數據資料得來的長爪。必殺技有以長爪攻擊對手的「貓貓拳」，以及用銳利眼神操控敵人的「貓眼」。中了這道眼神的對象會自己攻擊自己。

description.en: An Amphibian Digimon that mesmerizes those around it with a cry altogether too pleasant for its strange appearance. Gekomon jams chords with the three holes on its tongue and horn wrapped around its neck, which it uses to control its opponent’s feelings. Rumor has it that a Gekomon is born when a hit song is created in composition software, making it a kind of status symbol among musicians the world over. Its special move Symphony Crusher destroys the enemy’s insides with ultra-high frequency vibrations.
description.zh: 擁有著從奇特外觀難以想像的美妙l叫聲，使周遭入迷的兩棲型數碼寶貝。使用舌尖上三個洞奏響的和聲，以及捲在脖子上的號角的即興演出，可以任意控制對方的情緒。傳聞用作曲軟體創造出名曲的時候，怪蛙獸就會誕生，使其成為世上音樂工作者之間的一種身分象徵。必殺技是利用超高頻率振動，從內部破壞敵人的「碰撞交響樂」。

description.en: A Digimon shaped like a squid inhabiting the depths of the Net Ocean. Feared as the “White Demon of the Deep,” Gesomon is highly intelligent and won’t bring harm to Digimon outside of its territory. Still, any who invade its territory will face an onslaught akin to that of a raging god. It specializes in hit-and-run attacks, landing a blow before retreating far away. Its special move Devil Bashing is a combo attack utilizing its many limbs, and Deadly Shade blasts powerful squid ink that obscures the sight of its target for a long period of time.
description.zh: 棲息在網路深海，魷魚型態的數碼寶貝。以「深海的白惡魔」之名深受畏懼，卻擁有高度智慧，不會危及自己領地之外的數碼寶貝。不過，一旦侵犯到墨魚獸的領地，墨魚獸便會像怒不可遏的鬼神般展開襲擊。對手攻擊同時即刻脫離現場，打帶跑的風格。必殺技是活用許多的腳連續打擊的「邪魔痛擊」，以及中招後視覺會長時間麻痺的強力墨汁攻擊「死亡黑影」。

description.en: A novice Warrior Digimon active on the front lines of battle. Gladimon is a nimble fighter of small stature and light armor that often breaks through enemy lines to act as a scout. It specializes in tactics that link up with allies to make battle formations, giving it considerable fighting power as a platoon as well. Only those of its kind who gain victory in battle are said to Digivolve into great warriors. Gladimon uses its special move Wheel Rush to perform a spinning slash with its twin rapiers, and Sword Dancer to slice foes with its long arms as if it were dancing.
description.zh: 活躍於戰場前線，初出茅廬的戰士型數碼寶貝。由於身形嬌小又配備輕型裝備，動作靈敏迅速，能夠擔任偵察兵的角色深入敵陣。也擅長與同伴合作以組成陣型的戰略，以小隊來說的戰鬥力也十分高強。據說只有在戰場上連戰連勝的劍鬥士獸才能進化為偉大的戰士。必殺技是以雙手的護手刺劍使出迴旋斬擊的「旋轉猛衝」，以及以舞蹈般的動作用修長的雙手切碎敵人的「劍舞」。

description.en: Golemon is a Rock/Mineral Digimon discovered during a digital analysis of an ancient curse. An ancient spell consisting of the words “plague,” “curse,” and “evil,” is carved onto its back, apparently for the purpose of protecting it from its own poison gas. Roughly 90% of its body is composed of rock data, with limbs attached. It is an utterly emotionless Digimon that won’t move an inch unless ordered to do so.
description.zh: 對超古代詛咒進行數位分析時發現的岩石、礦物型數碼寶貝。背上雕刻了「疫」、「咒」、「凶」等古代的禁忌咒文，這似乎是為了保護岩石獸不受自己散發的氣體所傷。身體約有九成是由岩石的數據組成，將手腳接在身體上以得以生存。沒有受到命令就不會採取行動，是沒有感情的數碼寶貝。

description.en: A Tyrannosaurus-type Dinosaur Digimon. Specialized in offense, its extreme combat instinct accompanies a ruthless and brutal nature that won’t stop until the opponent is annihilated. Normal Digimon cannot approach Greymon, as they are kept at bay from the bizarre fighting spirit it emanates. Its Mega Flame shoots a flame that burns the vicinity, and its Atomic Tail hammers foes in a 360 degree arc. The charge technique Horn Strike is effective for both approach and retreat, and its sturdy frame lets it display tremendous fighting strength in close-quarters combat. Each skill has immense destructive power. Between its actions and wit, defeating Greymon in close-range combat is nigh-impossible. It won’t even show mercy to its own kind, meaning using Greymon is nothing if not infeasible.
description.zh: 暴龍類的恐龍型數碼寶貝。其攻擊力與眾不同，且擁有十分強烈的戰鬥本能。個性凶殘，在消滅對手前絕對不會停止攻擊。由於散發著異於常人的鬥志，普通的數碼寶貝完全不敢靠近。暴龍獸能夠噴出「超級火焰」將四周燃燒殆盡，而且不管敵人在哪個方向都能用「疾風尾」重擊對方。此外還有在接近敵人或後退時皆能發揮作用的突擊技「巨角強襲」。這些招式搭配上結實的身體，在近身戰中特別能展現出無與倫比的戰鬥力。暴龍獸每一項招式都有著極大的破壞力，而且動作也十分敏捷，因此在近身戰中要使其落敗可說是難如登天。只要發生衝突，即使對方是同族的數碼寶貝，暴龍獸也不會手下留情，因此要操控暴龍獸非常困難。

description.en: A Dark Dragon Digimon known as the “Deep Crimson Dragon.” The childishness from its time as Guilmon is gone, as it has Digivolved into a wilder, more ferocious creature. Although it is a Virus Digimon, Growlmon may become loyal depending on how its Tamer raises it. In fact, it might even fight for justice. Its roar is mighty enough to shake the ground, and Growlmon uses it as an aggressive display to intimidate the enemy before battle. It uses its signature move Plasma Blade to generate plasma with its forearm blades and attack the enemy. It also has the special move Exhaust Flame, by which it unleashes a powerful blast of fire with an explosive roar.
description.zh: 被稱為「深紅魔龍」的魔龍型數碼寶貝。抹去了基爾獸時期的稚氣，進化成更加粗野凶狠的數碼寶貝。另外，雖然古拉獸是病毒種數碼寶貝，但是根據馴獸師的栽培方式不同，也有可能忠心侍主、為正義而戰。古拉獸的咆哮威力足以撼動大地，戰鬥前會發出具攻擊性的低鳴威嚇敵人。擅長的招式是從雙肘的刀刃製造等離子、攻擊敵人的「等離子刃」。必殺技是伴隨著爆炸聲響噴出強力火焰的「排射火炎」。

description.en: A Machine Digimon that protects computer network firewalls. Guardromon used to fight off anyone attempting to breach a firewall alongside “Net Keeper” Giromon, until malicious hackers infected Guardromon with a virus to make use of its impregnable defensive abilities. These hackers now use Guardromon to protect themselves from a group of righteous Vaccine Digimon known as the Virus Busters. Since Guardromon’s basic programming only involves commands to defend, it has no problem repelling invaders regardless of its new role. It uses its special move Destruction Grenade to pursue invaders to the ends of the earth, then destroys them. However, Guardromon will only ever attack intruders.
description.zh: 守護電腦網路防護牆的機械型數碼寶貝。守衛獸原本是與「網路守門員」砲彈獸一同守護網路防護牆，擊退不法入侵者的數碼寶貝。不過有惡劣的駭客看上守衛獸銅牆鐵壁般的防禦力，因此讓守衛獸感染了電腦病毒，利用守衛獸來保護自己，不被疫苗屬性的正義集團「病毒剋星」攻擊。由於守衛獸基本上只有「防禦」這項程式指令，即使立場改變，只要能夠擋下入侵者就不會產生太大的問題。必殺技是追著不法入侵者直到世界盡頭、摧毀對方的「毀滅榴彈」。只要不採取不法入侵的手段，守衛獸就不會發動攻擊。

description.en: An Armor Beast Digimon that has Digivolved through the Digi-Egg of Love. The Digi-Egg of Love has the attribute of wind, allowing those who equip it to spread their wings and soar through the heavens, like a gale whipping through the ether.
