When it comes to aerial combat, Halsemon outclasses enemy Digimon in both speed and attack power. It uses its special move Mach Impulse to fire shockwaves from its wings, or Tempest Wing to generate massive tornadoes by spinning its body. Halsemon uses its signature move Udjat Gaze to fire a hypnotizing beam from a sharp glint in its eyes.
description.zh: 受到「愛情裝甲」之力影響而進化的裝甲體獸型數碼寶貝。「愛情裝甲」具備「風」屬性，裝備此數碼裝甲的數碼寶貝能夠自由翱翔，就如同從空中呼嘯而過的疾風。鐵鷹獸的速度與攻擊力在空戰中佔有相當的優勢，比敵方數碼寶貝還要厲害。必殺技是用翅膀發出衝擊波的「馬赫衝擊波」和透過旋轉身體產生巨大龍捲風的「暴風之翼」。擅長的招式是從銳利的雙眼發射的咒縛光線「電眼衝擊」。

description.en: A heavy infantry Digimon of the D-Brigade. It is said that many of the 100 Commandramon who don't pass the special screening exam Selection-D will Digivolve into Hi-Commandramon. Its main role is to act as a shield, protecting the Commandramon assault troops with its massive build and protective armor. Like Commandramon, its skin has been modified with a special texture that detects and displays surrounding colors in real time. Its special moves are DCD Grenade, which launches projectiles from a multi-grenade launcher, and Destroy Charge, a physical assault that uses its defensive shield. DCD Grenade is equipped with a special warhead that can instantly switch between explosive, smoke, and acoustic modes.
description.zh: 機械化旅團「D-旅團」的重裝步兵數碼寶貝。特殊選拔考驗「Selection-D」會篩選一百隻突擊龍獸，據說遭到淘汰的突擊龍獸大多會進化成高階突擊龍獸。主要職責是利用龐大身軀和防護盾，化為「盾」來守護突擊部隊。身體表面和突擊龍獸一樣，經過相同的特殊材質加工，具備即時投影周遭顏色的功能。必殺技是以連發式榴彈發射器射出的「DCD砲彈」，以及用防護盾衝撞的「毀滅衝擊」。「DCD砲彈」附有特殊彈頭，能夠瞬間切換榴彈、煙幕彈和聲彈。

description.en: After successfully acquiring accurate information from several investigations, Espimon upgrades its functions in order to gain more precise data. It can fly, sail, or dive long distances, going as deep as 20,000 meters down the Net Ocean or the same distance up into the sky to investigate hiding Digimon. Its camouflage move Divanish has also been upgraded. All traces of HoverEspimon will disappear, both visual and auditory, so it can easily infiltrate as needed or confuse its enemies. It utilizes its VR goggles to accurately calculate where targets will be several seconds in the future.
description.zh: 懸浮諜鼠獸是完成大量調查的諜鼠獸，為了獲得準確性更高的情報，而進化成更高機動性的型態。進化後可以進行長距離的航行、飛行與潛行，行動範圍甚至能到達「網路之海」的深處及高度20,000公尺的地方，而且還能查出藏匿起來的數碼寶貝。此外，可以施加光學迷彩效果的「潛行迷影」能力也提升了。不只是能將身體隱藏起來，就連聲音都可以消除，即使是在高速行動時，也能在不被發現的情況下潛入目的地或進行干擾。額頭上的虛擬實境眼鏡能預測並顯示出目標在數秒後的動向，以便採取準確的行動。

description.en: An Insectoid Digimon with a humanoid form and butterfly wings. Hudiemon is cautious at first, but reveals cheerful, playful expressions once it gets comfortable. It traverses the Digital World, fluttering elegantly in places the light touches. Hudiemon’s existence is akin to a backup of the Digital World, accessing the world’s records and saving the immense quantities of data within itself. Even if a disaster were to cause all records and memories of the Digital World to vanish, the lost data would be restored as long as Hudiemon is around.
description.zh: 擁有人形的型態及蝴蝶翅膀的昆蟲型數碼寶貝。一開始會充滿戒心，但在和羽蝶獸加深感情後，羽蝶獸就會展現出開朗又有趣的表情。會在有光芒照射的地方優雅地起舞，同時行遍了數碼世界各地。羽蝶獸被譽為數碼世界中有如備份檔的存在，能夠存取全世界的紀錄，將龐大的紀錄數據保存在自己身上。據說就算數碼世界哪天遭遇變異而使紀錄或記憶消失，只要羽蝶獸還在，就能讓失去的數據復原。

description.en: A Digimon with a body made of ice. Icemon’s origins are currently being researched. Perhaps it Digivolved from Gotsumon, or maybe it is some sort of mutation. Its special move Iceball Bomb involves throwing ice-cold frozen bombs at foes.
description.zh: 身體由冰組成的數碼寶貝。冰石獸究竟是由礦石獸進化而成，還是礦石獸變種的樣貌，這點仍然無人知曉，尚在研究當中。必殺技是將結凍得硬邦邦的冰炸彈丟向敵人的「冰球炸彈」。

description.en: A Sea Beast Digimon discovered in a computer at an arctic research facility. Ikkakumon’s thick pelt and sturdy body are made to withstand polar temperatures. The sharp horn growing from its head is made of Mithril, a rare metal, and the skin beneath its pelt is just as hard. Ikkakumon’s clawed limbs are capable of emitting blistering heat at will. As a result, Ikkakumon can always maintain a firm foothold when walking on ice, even if unable to move quickly. In combat, Ikkakumon will threaten opponents with a bold roar, much like a lion. Its special move is Harpoon Torpedo, by which it fires the horn on its head at opponents, as the horn can be regrown.
description.zh: 在北極探查基地的電腦發現的海獸數碼寶貝。有厚重的毛皮和強壯的身軀，其構造即使在極寒地帶也能生存。銳利的角是由稀有金屬之一的「祕銀」所構成，毛皮下的體膚也具備同等的硬度。腳尖爪子的部位是能依照自己的意志發出高溫的加熱裝置。因此海獅獸雖然能在冰上穩穩立足，卻無法移動得太快。戰鬥時會發出像獅子般威武的吼聲威嚇對手。必殺技是將可再生的角發射出去的「魚叉火神炮」。

description.en: A Digimon that’s a cross between the data of a dragon and a fighter jet. Jazardmon is capable of flying at high speeds, and its legs allow it to perform vertical takeoffs and landings. It even has the ability to hover. As for its personality, Jazardmon is an eccentric Digimon that enjoys reconnaissance as a hobby, and it always keeps a close watch on its surroundings. Since it has night vision, thermal sensors, ultrasonic detection, and other capabilities, Jazardmon is considered impossible to sneak up on.
description.zh: 外貌由龍與戰鬥機這兩種數據交雜而成的數碼寶貝。能夠高速飛行，而且因為有腳，能夠垂直起飛或落地，以及懸停。是以索敵為興趣的奇怪數碼寶貝，總是不會鬆懈於掌握周遭的情形。擁有夜視、熱感應和超音波等功能，一般認為想要神不知鬼不覺地靠近機龍獸是不可能的。

description.en: Even for a newly discovered Digimon, Kabuterimon is a highly unusual Insectoid Digimon. Though it's unclear how it came to be an Insectoid Digimon, it is understood to have the power of an ant and the defense system of a beetle. As you would expect from an insect, it only thinks about survival, and will do anything to ensure it. Hostile toward Virus Digimon, Kabuterimon will attacks one on sight without mercy. Its head is made from metal, granting it incredible defense. Its special move is Electro Shocker.
description.zh: 在新發現的數碼寶貝之中也算是十分奇特的昆蟲型數碼寶貝。雖然不曉得是經歷過什麼才進化成昆蟲類型，卻兼具螞蟻般的力量與甲蟲擁有的完美防禦能力。個性正如昆蟲一般，只有讓自己存活下來的本能，因此沒有半點智力。會毫不留情地襲擊與自身呈現敵對關係的病毒屬性數碼寶貝。頭部已經金屬化，以銅牆鐵壁般的防禦力著稱。必殺技是「百萬爆焰」。

description.en: A mysterious Ancient Digimon said to have been hunted to extinction due to the spread of the Internet. The wings of this Bird Digimon have completely degenerated, preventing it from taking flight. Kiwimon also bears some aspects of a Vegetation Digimon, with leaf-like objects growing from its head that it uses to absorb nutrients through photosynthesis. Aside from the hard shell covering its head, it has no way to defend itself, and its docile personality makes it an easy target. Its special move Pummel Peck uses the ChibiKiwimon hidden in its body to attack. The beaks of the ChibiKiwimon are incredibly hard, just like Kiwimon’s, and they explode when struck. These ChibiKiwimon will always come back, even if they’re charred to a crisp by the explosion.
description.zh: 據說是因網路普及而遭到濫捕，導致滅絕的夢幻古代數碼寶貝。奇鳥獸雖是鳥型數碼寶貝，但翅膀已經完全退化，無法飛行。而且奇鳥獸擁有植物型的構造，可以用頭部生長出來的樹葉般部位進行光合作用，補充養分。奇鳥獸個性溫和，除了覆蓋頭部的堅硬外殼以外，沒有其他保護自己的手段，因而容易受到外敵攻擊。必殺技是利用藏在身體裡的小奇鳥獸攻擊敵人的「小鳥啄擊」。小奇鳥獸的鳥喙和奇鳥獸一樣非常堅硬，受到攻擊還會爆炸，是相當可怕的招式。即使爆炸後變得焦黑，小奇鳥獸們仍會回去奇鳥獸的身體。

description.en: A Giant Bird Digimon with two extremely powerful legs. Having lived on the ground for so long, Kokatorimon has lost the ability to fly, and has Digivolved a body suited to surface life. This is why it has grown so large while developing tremendous leg strength. Kokatorimon’s wings have degenerated completely; in battle, it spreads them wide while displaying its tail to intimidate the enemy. While violent and ferocious by nature, it dislikes intense battles that consume the energy it needs in order to maintain its large body. Its special move is Petra Fire. Those hit by this fearsome attack are turned not to ash, but to stone.
description.zh: 巨鳥型數碼寶貝，發達的雙腳變得巨大。由於長期生活於陸地上，已經進化成適應陸地生活、無法飛行的身體。因此體型變得相當巨大，腿力也十分優越。翅膀的部分則是徹底退化，戰鬥時巨雞獸會豎起尾巴、張開翅膀，藉此威嚇敵人。雖然巨雞獸個性相當凶狠，但是為了維持巨大的身體，巨雞獸不擅長劇烈消耗能量的戰鬥。必殺技是「石化之火」。這一招十分可怕，如果被擊中，身體不會化作炭灰而是會石化。

description.en: An Insectoid Digimon with giant pincers on its head. Like Kabuterimon, Kuwagamon possesses combat abilities far surpassing those of its kin inhabiting File Island. While Kuwagamon enjoys the protection of its strength and sturdy shell, it uses the power of its pincers to squeeze the life out of any foe it catches. It has a completely hostile relationship with the Vaccine-type Kabuterimon. It can use its special move Scissor Claw to easily cut through tough objects.
description.zh: 頭部長出巨大夾鉗的昆蟲型數碼寶貝。和比多獸相同，比起棲息於檔案島的同種，戰鬥能力更加優秀。以強韌的力量與堅硬的甲殼保護自身，尤其是夾鉗的部份威力超強，只要一夾住敵人，在對手死去前絕對不會鬆開。古加獸與疫苗屬性的比多獸是死對頭，兩者之間只存在著「鬥爭」意識。必殺技是能夠輕易切開堅硬物體的「剪刀臂」。

description.en: A Mysterious Beast Digimon in the shape of a giant fox with nine tails. Kyubimon is feared as a beast bringing destruction and decay, but in ancient times it was hailed as a bringer of peace. A Renamon with particularly strong abilities and a wide range of experience is said to Digivolve into a Kyubimon. It lacks attack power, but possesses incredible spiritual energy and specializes in spells. The blue flames burning on its limbs supposedly allow Kyubimon to gallop through the heavens. Its signature move Fox Tail Inferno creates and controls will-o’-the-wisps. Its special move Dragon Wheel causes a dragon of blue flame to erupt from its tail to burn its foes.
description.zh: 有著巨大九尾狐狸外型的妖獸型數碼寶貝。雖被視為招致破滅與崩壞的妖獸而遭人畏懼，在古代則是被視為現身於和平之世的使者而受到尊崇。據說只有能力特別高強，累積了豐富經驗的妖狐獸才能夠進化成九尾狐獸。攻擊力本身並不強，但擁有強大的精神力，擅長「術系」的招式。據說燃燒著藍色烈火的四肢甚至可以馳騁天際。擅長的招式是產生可以隨意操縱的鬼火「鬼火玉」。必殺技是從尾巴發出旺盛燃燒的藍焰火龍，將敵人燃燒殆盡的「狐炎龍」。

description.en: A Digimon with a body made of lava that emits clouds of ash whenever it moves. Although Lavorvomon has wings, it struggles to use them, and spends most of its time crawling around on the ground. Despite this, it moves with surprising speed given its stolid appearance, and is capable of closing in on foes in an instant. Lavorvomon is very affectionate with those who’ve gained its trust, but since the ash its body gives off contains explosive particles, its friends are always running away for fear of an explosion.
description.zh: 全身由熔岩組成，會一邊噴出粉塵一邊活動的數碼寶貝。雖然長有翅膀卻不擅飛行，平常都在地面上爬行前進。外表鈍重，爬行速度卻十分驚人，能夠在一瞬間逼近敵人。性格友善，與信任的對象相處時不會有太多顧慮，但是噴出的粉塵有自燃特質，因此受到熔火波獸喜愛的人會害怕爆炸而全力逃走的樣子。

description.en: This Beast Man Digimon is known as the “King of Beasts,” and also the “Noble Hero.” Amidst the many frenzied Digimon out there, Leomon possesses both strength of will as well as a sense of justice, which it has wielded to defeat scores of villains. It has a rival in the “Digimon Hunter” Ogremon, which devotes itself entirely to acts of destruction. Leomon hones its formidable physique with daily training so that it can withstand all attacks, and it kill foes with its ultimate technique, the special move Fist of the Beast King. On Leomon’s waist hangs Shishiou-maru, the Beast Sword with a will of its own.
description.zh: 萬獸之王，也被稱為崇高勇者的獸人型數碼寶貝。數碼寶貝大多兇猛殘暴，獅子獸卻擁有堅毅的性格與正義之心，至今打倒了許多兇惡的數碼寶貝。同時也是破壞一切的「數碼寶貝獵手」奧加獸的勁敵。在每日鍛鍊之下所打造的強韌肉體能夠承受任何攻擊，必殺技究極奧義「獸王拳」能夠確實給予敵人最後一擊。腰上佩帶著擁有自我意識的妖刀「獅子王丸」。

description.en: A Cyborg Digimon in the pursuit of speed. Dust clouds on otherwise empty plains are usually caused by Machmon’s wild rides. Although Machmon resembles a motorcycle, it lacks any seat, nor does it have any intention of letting someone ride it. Despite this, it believes it will find a Digimon destined to drive it skillfully one day. A natural-born delinquent, Machmon is hostile to all things that move at high speeds.
description.zh: 追求速度的生化型數碼寶貝。如果空無一物的平原升起了煙塵，多半都是馬赫獸極速奔馳所導致的。外表看似一台機車卻沒有座位，不打算乘載任何人。但馬赫獸認為總有一天會找到能駕馭自己，命中註定的數碼寶貝。會把所有高速移動的對象視為敵人，是個貨真價實的飆車族。

description.en: A berserker that strengthened its combat instinct while sacrificing its intellectual capacity. Once a Lion-species Digimon, MadLeomon modified itself again and again until it became like this. Its consciousness disappeared in this process, transforming it into a puppet that defeats those who stand before it, as commanded. MadLeomon moves by instinct and lacks any thoughts, always charging madly ahead without regard to tricks or traps. While fundamentally powerful, its doesn’t have a vast array of attack fundamentals, sticking instead to punches or kicks. Even so, MadLeomon’s sharp claws contain poison that rots everything, so caution is warranted. The only attack that can be considered a special move is Beast Blaster, which shoots a blast of energy in the shape of a lion’s face. Any who stand in the way of this blast will be sent flying as they are torn to shreds.
description.zh: 失去思考能力並強化了戰鬥本能的狂戰士。原本是獅子型數碼寶貝，經過無數次的改造而變成如今的模樣。瘋狂獅子獸的意識在改造的過程中消失，最後轉變為只會遵照命令，打倒眼前敵人的人偶。由於瘋狂獅子獸只會按照本能行動，不會思考，因此就算碰上陷阱或圈套，瘋狂獅子獸也會奮力衝刺、毫不在意地進行突襲。雖然威力強大，但是攻擊方式相當單調且原始，通常只會揍人或踢人。只不過，瘋狂獅子獸的利爪含有劇毒、能夠腐蝕萬物，因此需要格外小心。唯一像必殺技的招數是「獸王墮拳」，這招能夠釋放出有著獅子臉形狀的「氣」。這股氣會一邊推進，一邊撕裂所有擋住去路的東西。

description.en: A power suit Digimon used by small-sized Digimon, making it the first Vehicle-species Digimon in the Digital World. Mekanorimon is unique as it cannot control itself, and must be piloted by other Digimon at all times or it cannot function. Given its Virus attribute, the Digimon controlling it can also be considered a Virus Digimon. It is still in development, meaning its DigiCore will overheat if it is used too much. Its special move Gyro Break is an explosive, mechanical corkscrew punch, and Twinkle Beam is fired from the linear lens embedded in its torso. Any enemy hit by the Twinkle Beam loses control of their body.
description.zh: 小型數碼寶貝專用的強化服數碼寶貝，也是數碼世界第一個載具系的數碼寶貝。機械裝甲獸是個奇特的數碼寶貝，無法自己行動，沒有其他數碼寶貝操縱的話就無法活動。從機械裝甲獸具備病毒屬性的這一點來看，操縱機械裝甲獸的數碼寶貝恐怕也是病毒屬性的數碼寶貝。機械裝甲獸是仍在開發中的數碼寶貝，過度使用的話電腦核（數碼核心）會過熱。必殺技是讓機械動力炸裂的螺旋式拳擊「迴旋碎擊」，以及用身體內部的線性透鏡照射的「閃光炮」。中了這招的敵人，身體就會無法自由行動。

description.en: A Fire Digimon whose body is shrouded in crimson flames. A Digimon generated by the defensive Firewall built to prevent illegal intrusion into networks such as the Internet, Meramon’s violent temperament reflects the flames surrounding it, burning everything it touches to a crisp. Possessing the most powerful flames of its ilk on File Island, this Digimon is extremely difficult to tame. Even those who tame it can’t predict when it will turn on them. Meramon uses its special move Burning Fist to flare up its arms before punching the opponent.
description.zh: 全身包覆著紅蓮之火的火焰型數碼寶貝。是從防止非法進入網路等場域的防護牆「防火牆」產生的數碼寶貝，一如包裹其身軀的火焰，生性激動，想要燒盡自己觸碰到的一切。火力比檔案島上的同種更加強大，想要馴服這種數碼寶貝十分困難。就算是馴服了，也不知道自己什麼時候會受到火焰獸的危害。必殺技是讓雙臂熊熊燃燒，徹底毆打對手的「火焰重拳」。

description.en: A hairy Rare Animal Digimon covered in a thick white coat. It lives in remote snowy regions, making sightings quite rare. In spite of the various reports of Mojyamon encounters, no evidence has confirmed its existence, and so for a long time the Digimon has been considered to be a mere fantasy. A gentle creature that never shows any hostility. Even so, it treats its den and territory as sacred grounds, and does not forgive any who would invade its holy land. Its special move Icicle Rod hurls a massive icicle formed instantly from water in the atmosphere, and Boomerang Bone chucks the frozen bone of an Ancient Digimon.
description.zh: 全身覆蓋著白色體毛，毛茸茸的珍獸型數碼寶貝。毛人獸棲息在雪山深處，不容易遇見。雖然有很多目擊毛人獸的報告，但沒有能證實其存在的決定性證據，因此毛人獸有很長一段時間都被認為是幻想出來的數碼寶貝。毛人獸個性溫和，絕非好戰。然而，毛人獸把自己的住處與地盤視為聖地，絕對不會饒恕在聖地撒野之徒。必殺技是將大氣中的水分瞬間凍結，製造出巨大冰柱的「冰柱棒」，以及投擲冰凍的古代數碼寶貝骨頭的「骨骨迴力鏢」。

description.en: An Armored Dragon Digimon with a rhinoceros-like horn growing from its snout. When that massive horn grows, it stands at half of its body length. A hard substance covers its horn and the top half is tough like diamond. They say there is nothing it cannot pierce. Monochromon is known to excel at both offense and defense. Although it is herbivorous and comparatively docile, once it is angered it will unleash fearsome counterattacks with its tank-like body. Its special move Volcanic Strike is a powerful flame projectile.
description.zh: 鼻尖上長著犀牛般的角，鎧龍型數碼寶貝。角龍獸的巨角成長後，角長可達身體的一半以上。巨角部位以及覆蓋著一半身體的堅硬物質擁有與鑽石同等的硬度，據說沒有角龍獸的角刺不穿的東西。角龍獸可說是攻守能力都很優越的數碼寶貝。有著草食性的性格，相對來說比較溫和，然而一旦受到激怒，角龍獸便會運用如同重型坦克般的身體展開令人畏懼的反擊。必殺技是強力的火焰彈「火山強襲」。

description.en: An Armor Holy Beast Digimon that has Digivolved with the Digi-Egg of Light. The Digi-Egg of Light has the attribute of light, allowing those who equip it to purify darkness with its luminescent power. Even though Gatomon is not a descendant of an ancient species of Digimon, it is able to armor Digivolve into Nefertimon by awakening a dormant special ability in its composition data. Its special moves are Curse of the Queen, by which it fires a red laser beam from the ornament on its forehead, and Rosetta Stone, by which it summons an enormous stone tablet engraved with ancient inscriptions in DigiCode to attack its foe.
description.zh: 透過「光明裝甲」的力量進化而成的裝甲體聖獸型數碼寶貝。「光明裝甲」具備「光」屬性，裝備此數碼裝甲的數碼寶貝會持有以強大的光之力量淨化黑暗的能力。並非古代種族後裔的迪路獸，也會因為構成其身體的數據資料中沉睡著的特殊能力覺醒，變得可以裝甲進化。必殺技是從額頭的飾品發出高溫紅色光線的「女王之詛咒」，以及召喚出刻有數碼文字的古代碑文巨石來攻擊敵人的「羅塞塔石碑」。

description.en: A slug-like Mollusk Digimon. Fond of damp, dark places, Numemon lacks both strength and intelligence. Any Digimon can become a Numemon if it isn’t raised properly, but perhaps it has hidden depths? Then again, even its attacks are bottom-tier, as it flings its own poop to repel enemies.
description.zh: 身體像是蛞蝓一樣的軟體型數碼寶貝。喜歡陰暗潮濕的環境，攻擊力零，也沒有智慧。不管是哪一種數碼寶貝，如果培育的方式錯了，就有可能變成鼻涕獸，不過這之中似乎藏著某些祕密……為了防禦外敵，鼻涕獸會使出超級低俗的攻擊，那就是丟出自己的大便。

description.en: A ghostlike Undead Digimon that dwells in graveyards. It is a gleeful fighter that delights in battling even opponents far stronger than itself. Oboromon's strange fixation on winning is thought to be because it absorbs large amounts of grudge-filled data from the Digimon it defeats. However, Oboromon is not egotistical. When it is not in battle, it can usually be found aimlessly wandering around graveyards. It has been witnessed having odd conversations with the skull fused with its left arm. The katana growing from the skull is brittle and shatters easily, but no matter how many times the katana breaks a new one will grow.
description.zh: 如同幽靈一般棲息在墓地的不死型數碼寶貝，是個在遇到強大的對手時也絕不退縮，且會不擇手段戰鬥的狂戰士。對於獲勝異常地執著，這可能是和朧魂獸大量吸收了戰敗數碼寶貝們的怨念數據有關。不過，朧魂獸本身幾乎沒有自我意識，在非戰鬥狀態下會像發楞一樣在墓地裡徘徊，有時候會被目擊到與和左手融為一體的野獸頭骨詭異地交談著。雖然從左手頭骨長出的刀脆弱易折，但卻擁有每次斷掉後就會重新長出的特性。

description.en: A Mollusk Digimon discovered in a virus that a malicious hacker used when trying to crash a rival’s computer. Octomon is an obsessive collector, sporting claws at the end of its tentacles that it obtained from Devidramon’s data, and covering itself in Digi-Treasure that it’s scavenged from the depths of the Net Ocean. Many Fujitsumon, which are a small type of shellfish Digimon, attach themselves to the pot that Octomon wears on its head. These Fujitsumon have highly developed senses, and it’s believed that they are part of a symbiotic relationship with Octomon, warning it when they sense danger. Octomon’s special move is Spurting Ink, by which it fires out a blast of highly poisonous ink.
description.zh: 從邪惡的駭客為了破壞對手的探索電腦所使用的病毒中，發現了這種軟體型數碼寶貝。八爪魚獸有收集癖，其觸手前端裝備著從邪龍獸的數據資料中取得的爪子，身上戴著從網路之海的底部撿到的數碼寶物。蓋住八爪魚獸頭頂的壺上吸附著一種小型數碼寶貝──貝型的藤壺獸。藤壺獸的感覺十分敏銳，一察覺到危險便會警告八爪魚獸，因此普遍認為兩者是共生關係。必殺技是發射裝滿劇毒墨水的子彈「海鳴墨槍」。

description.en: An Armor Holy Beast Digimon that has Digivolved with the Digi-Egg of Hope. The Digi-Egg of Hope has a holy attribute, allowing those who equip it to wield sacred power. This allows Pegasusmon to exhibit absolute power against evil beings. It uses its signature move Rodeo Gallop to unleash ferocious blows with its hind legs. Its special move Silver Blaze fires a holy beam from its forehead, and Shooting Star drops meteors from outer space formed within its wings.
description.zh: 透過「希望裝甲」的力量進化而成的裝甲體聖獸型數碼寶貝。「希望裝甲」具備「神聖」屬性，裝備此數碼裝甲的數碼寶貝能獲得神聖力量。獲得這個力量的數碼寶貝可對邪惡發揮絕對性的強度。擅長的招式是用後腳施展強烈一擊的「競技疾馳」。必殺技是從額頭釋放神聖光線的「銀色光芒」，以及在兩翼內側製造出宇宙空間，打出流星的「射擊之星」。

description.en: A Digimon resembling a boy dancing freely across the sky. Petermon entices young Digimon who refuse to Digivolve with a promise to build a land only for kids, then invites them to Never-Ever Land, a world it built itself. Its personality seems innocent and naive, but underneath that purity lurks a certain degree of brutality. Petermon is particularly harsh toward Digimon who break promises, beating them down in a “punishment game.” Its swordplay is top-notch, and it deftly brandishes the knife on its waist to punish foes. Petermon hounds the enemy with a scornful smile, using Snipe Sting to attack the opponent’s vitals with precise strikes, and Twinkle Shoot to pursue foes until it scores a hit. It also uses Midnight Fantasia to freely control nearby young Digimon while they slumber with a light, whistling tune.
description.zh: 自由自在地飛翔於空中，有著少年外表的數碼寶貝。彼得獸會以「我們一起打造只屬於孩子的國度吧」的說法引誘拒絕進化的年幼數碼寶貝，把對方帶到自己所建立的孩子世界──「永無島」。據說個性天真無邪，但是也有單純得殘忍的一面。尤其是對於背棄約定的數碼寶貝，彼得獸會以「懲戒遊戲」為藉口，毫不留情地擊倒對方。彼得獸劍術一流，能夠巧妙地揮舞腰上的劍制裁敵人。「狙擊刺殺」是使出精彩的劍法，每一擊都準確刺中對方致命處的招式，「閃爍投射」則是丟出會追著敵人直到命中的武器，會用這兩個招式一邊嘲笑一邊纏著對方。。另外，彼得獸能以輕快的口哨旋律使出「午夜幻想曲」，讓近處熟睡的幼小數碼寶貝在保持睡眠的狀態下，任由彼得獸擺佈操控。

description.en: A rare Digimon that fears its own extinction, Porcupamon is classified as one of the Red Data Digimon. This Digimon did not originally reside in the Dark Area, but started living there after it was driven away by several other species. Its body is covered in a special leather, and this wicked-looking suit is thought to be a disguise to allow it to survive in the dog-eat-dog environment that is the Dark Area. Porcupamon uses its special move Madness Broach to stab the enemy with its sharp body hair, or Slap and Rip to cut the enemy with edged claws.
description.zh: 被分類在瀕臨滅絕的數碼寶貝的一種，是瀕臨絕種的稀少數碼寶貝。豪豬獸原本並不是棲息在黑暗區域的種族，但由於被許多種族的數碼寶貝驅趕，現在居住在黑暗區域。身體被特殊的皮革素材包覆著，這身給人邪惡印象的套裝一般認為是在生存競爭最激烈的黑暗區域中，為了生存所需的擬態。必殺技是用銳利的體毛刺擊敵人的「瘋狂錐刺」和用刀刃形狀的爪子砍向敵人的「拍打撕裂」。

description.en: An Undead Digimon whose muscles have rotted off its body. Raremon tried to prolong its life by mechanizing its body, but the process didn’t stabilize, causing the data composing its body to start falling apart. Even so, these machine parts grant this creature life, preventing its death and allowing it to survive in this awful state. This crumbling form affords neither attack power nor intelligence, causing Raremon to act according to instinct. It emits a stench from its body awful enough to send In-Training Digimon running, and won’t fight anything below Champion level.
description.zh: 全身的肌肉都腐敗脫落的不死型數碼寶貝。意圖機械化身體以延長生命，身體卻無法穩定下來，組成身體的數據資料開始崩毀。但由於機械賜予了爛泥獸生命，爛泥獸不會死去，而是以醜陋的模樣繼續延長生命。由於身體已經崩毀，沒有攻擊力和智力，會遵循本能行動。全身散發出的惡臭甚至會讓幼年期的數碼寶貝拔腿就跑，卻不是成長到成熟期的數碼寶貝的敵人。

description.en: A strengthened version of Vegiemon, its entire body has ripened and turned red. RedVegiemon boasts formidable power and intelligence, unlike the unripened Vegiemon. This red ripened appearance is Vegiemon’s original form, likely brought about by the harsher environments of the Folder Continent. Its personality has become even more crafty and cunning. Its special move Hazard Breath is a blast of breath both foul and poisonous. Anyone who carelessly approaches RedVegiemon assuming it’s a Vegiemon will surely have a regrettable experience.
description.zh: 全身赤紅成熟的強化版鼻屎獸。與尚未成熟的鼻屎獸不同，攻擊力變強，也具有高智力。這個赤紅成熟的姿態才是鼻屎獸原本的樣貌，或許是因為資料夾大陸的環境更為殘酷，才讓鼻屎獸變為原本的樣貌。有著更為陰險、狡詐的個性。必殺技是吐出帶有強烈臭味和毒素的氣息「惡臭氣息」。如果因為是鼻屎獸就貿然出手，毫無疑問地會有悽慘下場。

description.en: Roachmon has the shiny black body of that most widely reviled of pests—the cockroach. Ever careful to stay out of sight, it moves around quite nimbly, although it goes even faster when running away. Despite having only lackluster offensive and defensive abilities, its boundless drive to live lets it really shine in an endurance match. Its special move is Dream Dust, where it scatters trash around.
description.zh: 散發著黑色光芒的軀體人見人厭，就像蟑螂一樣。會偷偷摸摸而迅速地四處爬竄，逃跑時的速度又更快。雖然幾乎無法對蟑螂獸的攻擊力和防禦力寄予期待，卻因為蟑螂獸擁有無可計量的生命力，遇到耐久戰時就會發揮出實力。必殺技是亂撒垃圾的「夢幻塵土」。

description.en: An Aquatic Digimon with a serpentine body. When attacked, Seadramon will wrap its long body around the enemy and squeeze them until they suffocate. Fundamentally lacking any kind of intelligence, Seadramon swims through the Net Ocean wherever its instincts take it. Its special move is Ice Blast, by which it breathes out from its mouth at absolute zero, instantly freezing the water and blasting its opponent.
description.zh: 水棲型數碼寶貝，擁有大蛇般長長的身體。海龍獸會用長長的身體綑住攻擊自己的敵人，除非對方斷氣否則絕不放開。原本便沒有思考能力，因此都是依循本能在網路之海中來回游動。必殺技是從嘴裡吐出絕對零度的氣息，使水瞬間凍結後射向敵人的「寒冰箭」。

description.en: A Digimon shaped like a hermit crab inhabiting the depths of the Net Ocean. Shellmon has a turtle-like appearance when inside its shell, but its body is actually soft like a mollusk. Its body gets bigger and bigger as it grows, switching dwellings each time until it’s the size of a small mountain. Also, Shellmon has the custom of settling into anything it can push its whole body into. Its low intelligence and belligerent nature mean that anyone who encounters it needs to stay on guard. Its special move Hydro Blaster fires liquid at high pressure.
description.zh: 棲息在「網路之海」較淺的海底，有著寄居蟹外型的數碼寶貝。雖然樣貌像是住在貝殼裡的烏龜，其實身體像軟體動物般柔軟。由於身體會隨著成長越來越大，需要不斷替換住處，最後會變成像座小岩山一樣的大小。此外，貝殼獸有著只要身體能夠整個進去，無論任何地方都能住下的習性。雖智力不高但個性好戰，所以遇到貝殼獸的話千萬要小心。必殺技是用高壓發射液體的「超水壓炮」。

description.en: Older sister to Sistermon Blanc and twin to Sistermon Noir, Sistermon Ciel wears a veil shaped like a mouse on its head. Sistermon Ciel acts separately from its sisters Noir and Blanc, wandering the Digital World investigating various disturbances and sending information to Gankoomon about the areas it visits. Though demure by nature, Sistermon Ciel’s resolve is ironclad, and it tends to be popular with local Digimon wherever it goes. By day it goes about what appears to be a peaceful and charming life, and by night it abruptly turns into an assassin dedicated to hunting down any undesirable elements that it has learned about.
description.zh: 頭上戴著老鼠造型頭紗的數碼寶貝，是修女獸雪白的姊姊，與漆黑是雙胞胎。不與漆黑、雪白一同行動，為了調查變異與其他狀況而漂泊於數碼世界，再將各地的消息告知頑固獸。個性沉穩，卻有著堅強的內心，在旅行所至的各地也很受數碼寶貝們歡迎。白天會表現出和藹可親地平靜生活的一面，到了夜晚卻會搖身一變為暗殺者，去狩獵掌握情資的危險份子。

description.en: A nun Digimon that is a sister to Sistermon Blanc, clad in a klobuk shaped like the head of a black cat. Jovial by nature, Sistermon Noir calms others with its innocent behavior. Gankoomon ordered it to look after Huckmon, and so it accompanies the former on its journeys while training the latter. Still, Sistermon Noir tackles this task half in jest, laughing off any of Huckmon’s grief-stricken words and pointing its gun at its charge. In the past, the sisters were saved by Gankoomon just as they were on the brink of starvation. Sistermon Noir uses its special move Mickey Bullet to fire twin guns that it collectively refers to as “Anthony,” Bless Fire to shoot them in a straight line, or Grand Sister Cruz to finish off the enemy together with its sister.
description.zh: 頭上戴著黑貓造型修女帽的修女數碼寶貝，和修女獸雪白是姊妹。性格十分開朗，天真爛漫的舉止還能緩和氣氛。受頑固獸之託照顧哈克獸，跟著頑固獸旅行的同時訓練著哈克獸。但是修女獸漆黑採取一半修行一半玩樂的方式，即使哈克獸苦苦哀嚎，修女獸漆黑也是一笑置之並拿槍口對著哈克獸。

description.en: A leader among its peers who has exchanged cups of sworn brotherhood with DeadlyAxemon. SkullKnightmon is an extremely cunning knight, and operates based on its own philosophy: “Those who are knights must fight. And not just fight, but win.” It values victory above all else. Toward this end, it is not afraid to get its hands dirty. SkullKnightmon prides itself on combat utilizing its size, swooping in on its foes while swinging its Spear Needle, and displaying behavior one might not expect of a knight who has forgotten its pride.
description.zh: 與致命大斧獸結盟為兄弟，排行老大，是個滿腦子壞主意的騎士。行動準則的基礎是「身為騎士必須戰鬥。既然要打，那就不能輸」，十分重視贏得勝利這件事。只要能獲勝，無論是多麼骯髒的手段，骷髏騎士獸都能夠若無其事地利用。在戰鬥時擅長活用自己的體型，骷髏騎士獸飛進對手懷中，揮舞「槍針」的模樣看起來實在不像是遺忘了身為騎士的尊嚴。

description.en: A star-shaped Digimon discovered by chance in planetary analysis software installed at a space development center. Starmon is a space warrior in stellar power armor that wears boots and gloves emblazoned with a star symbol. Its ragged yellow scarf speaks to the many battles it has survived. Starmon’s eyes burn with fighting spirit in the center of its body, clearly conveying its desires in spite of its inability to speak. They can even be used in a more advanced fashion to hypnotize opponents. Starmon is a hot-blooded Digimon with a burning admiration for the warrior Leomon. Its special move is Meteor Shower, by which it calls down small meteors to crush its foe.
description.zh: 在宇宙開發中心的行星分析用軟體中偶然發現的行星系數碼寶貝。是著裝了星形裝甲服的宇宙戰士，也穿戴著鑲有星形標誌的拳套與靴子。破破爛爛的黃色圍巾訴說了星星獸的輝煌戰歷。身體中央的眼睛充滿鬥志，不說話也能將意志傳達給對手。此外，那雙眼睛還有更高等級的用法，就是向對手施以催眠術的能力。星星獸憧憬著勇者獅子獸，是滿腔熱血的數碼寶貝。必殺技是讓小型流星從敵人頭上墜落的「流星風暴」。

description.en: An extremely unusual Insectoid Digimon with a humanoid shape. Stingmon possesses both the hard exoskeleton and simple movements characteristic of Insectoid Digimon. Excelling as an assassin, it prides itself on attacks that target enemy vitals with agile movements and precise judgment, silencing them with a single strike. Stingmon possesses a calm, cool, and highly intelligent personality. It uses its fearsome signature move Spiking Strike to skewer foes with the spikes on its arms.
description.zh: 擁有人形的型態，相當稀有的昆蟲型數碼寶貝。擁有昆蟲型數碼寶貝特有的堅硬外骨骼以及迅速的行動。身為暗殺者的能力十分高強，會以敏捷的身段及準確的判斷力攻向敵人的要害，擅長只用一擊就使敵人沉默下來的攻擊。極其冷靜又充滿知性，個性很酷。必殺技是以雙臂的尖刺穿刺敵人的可怕招式「終結刺釘」。

description.en: A Vegetation Digimon resembling a sunflower. Sunflowmon gets a real energy boost when it’s exposed to sunlight, which makes its attacks more powerful. On sunny days, it may even fly around by flapping the two leaves growing from its back. Its special moves include Sunshine Beam, where it releases a blast of sunlight from its petals, and Smiley Slap, which involves slapping its opponent with a big smile on its face. Enemies find this intimidating, as the smile itself is quite creepy. Sunflowmon also has Cactus Tail, which involves swinging its tail-like stalk to shower enemies with thorns.
description.zh: 外表如同向日葵的植物型數碼寶貝。一沐浴在陽光之下就會非常有精神，攻擊力也會提升。在天氣好的日子，有時候也會拍動背上的葉子飛翔。必殺技是由所有花瓣釋放太陽光的「陽光射線」，以及帶著笑容賞敵人巴掌的「微笑巴掌」。此外，向日葵獸的笑容因為十分詭異而令人恐懼。另外還有甩動如同尾巴的莖，射出棘刺的「仙人掌之尾」這一招。

description.en: A Cyborg Digimon who resembles a tank. Tankmon is also known as the “Mercenary Digimon,” backing up both Vaccine and Virus Digimon alike if there’s profit to be made. It pulverizes incoming enemies to dust with its heavyweight power and the heavy weaponry all over its body. A conflict enthusiast, Tankmon heads in the direction of any strife that pops up. Wherever this lone wolf goes, conflict is sure to continue unceasingly. It uses its special move Hyper Cannon to launch a super-powerful missile from the gun barrel on its head.
description.zh: 外觀呈現戰車模樣的生化型數碼寶貝。坦克獸擁有「傭兵數碼寶貝」的別名，如果自己能得到好處，不管要坦克獸加入疫苗屬還是病毒屬都可以。會以重量級的威力與裝設於全身的大型兵器將攻來的敵人粉身碎骨。非常喜歡鬥爭，會前去參加發生於各地的爭端。在這個有如孤狼的數碼寶貝所到之處，總是少不了紛爭。必殺技是從頭部的砲管發射超強力導彈的「高壓加農炮」。

description.en: The Digivolved form of Ludomon, having grown even more durable while gaining superb fleetness of foot. TiaLudomon dashes around at high speeds to rescue Digimon left on the front lines unable to fight. It transforms itself into a shield, protecting its wielder from any attacks that come their way as they escape the battlefield. TiaLudomon’s shields are magic, capable of erecting ice barriers to freeze and nullify enemy attacks. It uses its special move Frisbicker to throw the shields on its arms, or Assault Claw to attack with its claws at high speed.
description.zh: 路德獸變得更加強壯，且獲得優秀的敏捷雙腳後進化而成的模樣。會以高速衝刺，救援被留在戰地而無法戰鬥的數碼寶貝。為了離開戰地，會讓對方拿著自己變化而成的盾牌，不管遇到什麼樣的攻擊都能守住保護的對象。提亞路德獸的盾牌是能夠展開冰之結界的魔法盾牌，可以凍結敵人的攻擊並使其無效化。

description.en: An Aquatic Digimon that pursues its prey at high speeds. Tobiumon’s bizarrely developed fins give it the ability to fly, and its large arms allow it to move on the ground. It takes down targets on land, sea and air, earning it the nickname “Hunter Fish.” After Tobiumon dulls its prey’s movements with Suckerfish Darts, which are organic missiles fired from its stomach, it lands a killing blow with Flying Finish, which is a high-speed slash with sharp fins.
description.zh: 會以高速將盯上的獵物逼上絕境的水棲型數碼寶貝。異常發達的魚鰭能夠用來飛行，巨大的雙手則能夠在地面上移動。由於在陸海空都能解決目標，擁有「獵手魚」的外號。

description.en: A Vegetation Digimon resembling a giant cactus. It ability to store nutrient data inside its body allows it to survive for extended periods even in barren desert regions. As is obvious from its facial expression, it’s usually impossible to tell what Togemon is thinking, since it spends most days staring blankly into space. But if provoked enough, its demeanor becomes violent and unhinged. Togemon’s special move is Needle Spray, by which it hardens the needles on its fists and unleashes a flurry of punches.
description.zh: 巨大仙人掌外型的植物型數碼寶貝。能在體內保存營養數據資料，在一片荒蕪的沙漠地帶也能生存一段時間。從表情就能看得出來，仙人掌獸平時完全不知道在想什麼，幾乎整天都在發呆。然而，仙人掌獸一旦被激怒就會性情大變，並失控暴動到令人束手無策。必殺技是讓手臂前端的刺更加硬化再使勁毆打的「尖尖碰碰拳」。

description.en: A tortoise-type Digimon equipped with a shell covered in sharp blades. Tortomon’s shell and body are both incredibly dense, making it heavier than it looks. In fact, it causes terrible earthquakes whenever it takes a step. Its shrill, metallic cry has also earned it the nickname “Noisy Digimon.” Tortomon’s walking movements are extremely slow, but it can retract its limbs and spin in a disc shape to move ten times faster than normal. It uses its special move Shell Phalanx to launch the blades on its shell like multi-warhead missiles.
description.zh: 裝備著表面長出利刃的甲殼，陸龜型的數碼寶貝。由於甲殼、本體兩者的密度都很高，因此實際體重比看起來還要重，每走一步都會發出巨響。而且叫聲尖銳，有種金屬感，因此別名是「噪音數碼寶貝」。平時走路十分緩慢，但是縮起四肢，變成圓盤狀旋轉的時候，移動的速度會比平常快上至少十倍。必殺技是像發射多彈頭飛彈般，將甲殼上的利刃彈出的「甲殼飛刀」。

description.en: An artificial Digimon created by filling a unique rubber body with energy stolen from other Digimon. Troopmon is like a machine that simply carries out orders with no capacity to act on its own. It is also tireless, immune to pain, unafraid of death, and doesn’t require sleep. It is essentially a fighting machine. Troopmon tend to act in groups, and while the combat ability of each individual isn’t very high, their sheer numbers when they charge forward in a wave combined with their combat familiarity make them a force to be reckoned with. Injured Troopmon have the energy inside them sucked out and transferred to another body made of the same specialized rubber. They are reborn as new Troopmon to be sent back into battle time and time again.
description.zh: 人造數碼寶貝。由特殊橡膠製成的身體裡裝滿了從其他數碼寶貝身上搶來的能量。兵卒獸只會按照命令行事，完全不會自主行動，就像機器一樣。而且不會感受到疲憊或痛楚，也不害怕死亡、不須睡覺。簡直就是戰鬥機器。基本上採取團體行動。個體的戰鬥力雖然不高，但是面對兵卒獸以數量取勝的人海戰術，如果只是對自己的實力有點自信，可能會吃下敗仗。受傷的兵卒獸體內的能量會被抽出，將能量移轉至新的特殊橡膠身體後便會生成新的兵卒獸，藉此不斷加入戰局。

description.en: A super heavy Dinosaur Digimon with giant horns growing from its shoulders. Tuskmon’s foolhardy personality means it will charge at and destroy every obstacle in its path, earning it the nickname “Panzer Digimon.” Specializing in charging tackles, countless Digimon have fallen before its attacks. The stars on both arms represent the number of Digimon it’s defeated (a hundred per mark). If Tuskmon’s horns break, it can shed them like shark teeth and bring new horns from the back to the front, making any attempt to destroy its horns fruitless. Its special move Slamming Tusk is a super dreadnought-class punch.
description.zh: 雙肩長著巨大犄角的超重量級恐龍型數碼寶貝。個性衝動莽撞，不論眼前有何種障礙物，都會將其全部衝撞破壞，所以有著「戰車數碼寶貝」的別稱。大角獸擅長衝撞系的撞擊招式，遭其衝撞攻擊所擊沉的數碼寶貝不計其數。雙臂上的星形標記代表著目前為止打倒的數碼寶貝數量（一顆星代表一百隻）。此外，大角獸雙肩的犄角即使折斷，也會像鯊魚牙齒般從脫落的斷角底下長出新角，因此破壞其犄角也是白費力氣。必殺技是極度強大的拳擊「裝甲車拳」。

description.en: An ancient Dinosaur Digimon that existed in the prehistoric world. Tyrannomon mows down everything with its two powerful arms and massive tail. It possesses intelligence and a docile personality, however, and is easy to tame. This makes Tyrannomon a hot commodity among beginning Tamers, many of whom raise theirs with care. One could say it represents what Digimon are all about. It uses its special move Fire Breath to exhale flames the same color as its deep crimson body.
description.zh: 長得像是存在於史前時代的恐龍般的數碼寶貝，會用發達的雙臂與巨尾撂倒一切。由於巨龍獸腦袋聰明且個性沉穩、容易駕馭，因此是初級馴獸師的首選，大多數人都會用心照顧。可以說是最具有代表性的基本數碼寶貝。必殺技是吐出與皮膚同色的深紅火焰──「火焰吐息」。

description.en: Unimon is a Mythical Beast Digimon based on mythical creatures of legend, with the wings of Pegasus and the horn of a unicorn. The large wings on its back allow it to travel across the Network in the blink of an eye, while it uses the sharp horn on its forehead to stab foes. A "wild" Unimon is as hot-blooded as any untamed horse, but once trained can come to act as one with its rider. Unimon’s special move Holy Shot involves firing an energy bomb from its large mouth.
description.zh: 具備獨角獸的角與天馬的翅膀，同時擁有這兩種傳說中聖獸特徵的合成數碼寶貝。藉由背部生長的巨大翅膀，轉眼間便能在電腦網路世界四處疾馳，利用額頭延伸出來的銳利尖角刺向敵人。野生(？)的獨角馬獸個性就像悍馬一般暴躁，但若成功馴服，就能操縱自如地驅使獨角馬獸。必殺技是從巨大的嘴部吐出氣功彈的「神聖射擊」。

description.en: Vilemon is a strong-willed Little Devil Digimon that’s a terribly sore loser. As a result, it refuses to engage in combat directly, instead needling and tormenting those weaker than itself like the coward that it is. It’s thought to be the source of all Dark Digimon living in the Dark Area, but many mysteries around it still remain. Its special move is Nightmare Shock, whereby it produces supersonic waves from its mouth to trap opponents in a nightmare from which they can never awake.
description.zh: 爭強好勝的小惡魔型數碼寶貝。為了贏不會正面對決，而是卑鄙地不停折磨弱小。雖然有人認為邪魔獸是居住於黑暗區域的黑暗系數碼寶貝的起源，但是其中還有許多待解的謎題。必殺技是從口中發出超音波，讓對方陷入無盡惡夢的「惡夢驚狂」。

description.en: A Vegetation Digimon resembling a great withered tree. Made of normal wood, Woodmon catches Digimon that pass by and absorbs their energy to survive. It can also use its root-like limbs to move. Brutal by nature, it will attack without rest when angered. Woodmon’s sturdy wooden trunk boasts high defense, but it is extremely weak to flame, particularly Fire Digimon such as Meramon and Birdramon. It uses its special move Branch Drain to extend its branch-like appendages, pierce the opponent, and absorb its energy.
description.zh: 外表如同枯朽巨樹的植物型數碼寶貝。平常會假裝成一棵普通的樹，藉此捕捉經過的數碼寶貝，吸收對方的能量。另外，長得橡樹根一樣的腳能夠用來移動。性格凶暴，一旦被惹怒就不會停止攻擊。身體是堅硬的樹幹，雖然防禦力高卻很怕火，相當不擅長面對火焰獸或巴多拉獸等火焰系數碼寶貝，並且將這類數碼寶貝視為敵人。必殺技是伸長枝狀手臂刺向敵人、吸收能量的「吸命樹枝」。

description.en: A Vegetation Digimon resembling a roasted sweet potato. Yakiimon trains with an all-consuming, fiery passion to become the champion. The more its body warms up, the more its punching and its footwork improve as well. The trouble is, even it’s not sure what it means to become champion, so it just keeps on training endlessly. Its special moves include Beniazuma Straight, where it packs all of its power into a right-handed punch, and Beniazuma Uppercut, which involves concentrating all the heat it has built up into an upward punch with its left hand, sending its opponent flying along with a burst of steam.
description.zh: 外表如同烤番薯的植物型數碼寶貝。為了得到冠軍而進行著忍耐酷熱的特訓，身體越溫暖，出拳的力道和機動力就能得到越強的提升。但就連烤地瓜獸自己都不知道是要得到什麼東西的冠軍，就只是不斷地努力著。 必殺技是在右拳上灌注全副力道後擊出的「紅薯直拳」，以及對左拳灌注暖呼呼的熱量後朝著敵人揮去，讓對手隨著熱氣一起被炸上高空的「紅薯上擊拳」。

description.en: Youkomon is a Mysterious Beast Digimon in the shape of a giant blue fox with nine tails. Unlike Kyubimon, Youkomon is feared as a strange beast that brings only destruction and decay. It lacks attack power, but possesses incredible spiritual energy and specializes in spells. The red flames burning on its limbs supposedly allow Youkomon to gallop through the heavens. Its signature move Blazing Spheres involves manifesting scorching hot balls of flame that it can control at will. Its special move Jaenryū causes a dragon of red flame to erupt from its tail to burn its foes.
description.zh: 長了九條尾巴，樣貌有如巨大青色狐狸的妖獸型數碼寶貝。和九尾狐獸不同，狐妖獸被視為招致破滅與崩壞的妖獸而遭人畏懼。攻擊力本身並不強，但擁有強大的精神力，擅長「術系」的招式，據說熊熊燃燒的火紅四肢甚至能馳騁於天際。擅長的招式是產生可以隨意操縱的灼燙火球「狐焰」。必殺技是從尾巴發出旺盛燃燒的紅焰火龍，將敵人燃燒殆盡的「邪炎龍」。

description.en: “I am the Twentiest! I won’t stop! I’ll keep on running!” With those words emblazoned on its soul, Zubamon Digivolved to ZubaEagermon. Its new form perfectly embodies that spirit, and ZubaEagermon is committed to constantly forging ahead, over good terrain and bad, even if it’s reduced to a crawl.
description.zh: 將「身為最二十的我不會停下腳步！我要一直一直跑下去！」這句話牢牢記在心裡的茲巴獸進化之後，變得更加勇往直前。無論碰上平地或險路都要前進，就算用爬的也要往前，一刻不停地向前衝刺就是茲巴伊戈獸的準則。

description.en: Andromon is a human-type Cyborg Digimon. It’s powerful enough to take out any Digimon of less than Ultimate level with a single blow. Developed as a prototype for Cyborg Digimon, Andromon was created as a machine-based model at the same time Boltmon was made to be an organic one. The same techniques were then appropriated for use in other Digimon, including MetalGreymon and Megadramon. Since Andromon is a prototype, it lacks emotions and has no will of its own, acting only in accordance with its programming. After its programming was upgraded based on data obtained from the Andromon on File Island, its strength increased dramatically. It uses its special move Spiral Sword to fire energy blades from its arms.
description.zh: 人形的生化數碼寶貝。戰鬥力足以一擊打倒尚未成為完全體的數碼寶貝。安杜路獸是生化數碼寶貝的試作型，以機械為基底的安杜路獸、以肉體為基底的生化數碼寶貝「科學怪人獸」是同一時期製造。這項技術也有應用於機械暴龍獸與超蛇龍獸。由於安杜路獸是試作型數碼寶貝，因此沒有自己的想法或情感，會完全依照程式的指令來行動。這種安杜路獸安裝的程式是由檔案島上的安杜路獸的數據升級更新而成，擁有強大無比的威力。必殺技是從手臂發射能量形成的刀刃「旋轉能量劍」。

description.en: A High Angel Digimon with the appearance of a beautiful woman. Though previously classified as an Angel Digimon, the great power of its abilities makes clear it is a High Angel Digimon. A Champion-level Angel has six wings and an Ultimate-level Angel has eight wings. Angewomon is calm by nature, but does not tolerate wickedness, and will continue attacking until its foe is reformed. Due to Angewomon’s strength of spirit and great power, it is regarded as a goddess of the Digital World. One of Angewomon’s special moves is the powerful lightning attack Celestial Arrow, also known as Heaven’s Punishment, while the other, a deadly beam attack filled with the essence of beauty and kindness known as Heaven’s Charm, is more effective the stronger the dark power of the opposing Digimon.
description.zh: 有著美麗女性樣貌的大天使型數碼寶貝。雖然以前被分類為天使型，但由於其能力之高，後來確定為大天使型。若以特徵來看，成熟期的天使有六片翅膀，而完全體的天使則是有八片翅膀。雖然性格極為溫和，但不會饒恕扭曲或邪惡之事，在對方改過自新之前不會放緩攻擊的力道。如此的精神與力量使其被喻為數碼世界的女神般的存在。必殺技為釋放強烈雷擊的「神聖弓箭」，此一招式也有「天誅」的別名。另一招則是充滿了美麗與善良的必殺光線「天堂紫光」，當對手數碼寶貝的邪惡力量越強，就越能發揮效果。

description.en: A Fire Digimon that burns hotter than a Champion Meramon. Its special move Ice Phantom inflicts frostbite on foes with sub-zero flames.
description.zh: 身上的火焰比成熟期的火焰獸還要高溫的火焰型數碼寶貝。必殺技是以超低溫的寒氣使對手灼傷的「冰之幻影」。

description.en: Cherrymon is a Digimon further Digivolved from Woodmon, gaining a high degree of intelligence and power. Known as the Lord of the Deep Forest, it is a terrifying Digimon that lures those who wander into the depths of the dark forest ever farther inside, so they can never leave again. Its body produces a hallucinogenic mist to lure Digimon deep into the forest. Then it uses its branch-like tentacles and vines to capture its enemies and draw nourishment from them. Should you ever encounter an old Woodmon, it may be best to defeat it before it can Digivolve into Cherrymon. Cherrymon’s special move Cherry Bomb makes use of the forbidden fruit growing in the thick branches on its head. The sweet scent of this fruit makes it seem quite tempting, but certain death awaits those who take even a single bite.
description.zh: 從朽木獸更進一步進化而成的是祖利獸，變得相當聰明且威力有所提昇。祖利獸被稱為樹海之主，是可怕的數碼寶貝，會把誤入森林深處的數碼寶貝引誘到更深的地方，讓對方永遠離不開森林。祖利獸能夠從身體釋放出令人陷入幻覺的霧，並將對方引誘到森林深處，以枝枒般的觸手與藤蔓抓住敵人，當成養分來源。如果發現活了很久的朽木獸，最好在朽木獸進化成祖利獸前打倒。必殺技是從頭部茂密的枝葉生出禁忌果實「櫻桃炸彈」。如果被果實的甜蜜香氣吸引誤食的話，只有死路一條。

description.en: A super-mini Machine Digimon used for healing. Originally a Vaccine-type Digimon for repairing crashed computers, Datamon’s thought processing circuits were corrupted after it was attacked by a strong Virus-type Digimon, causing it to go rogue. It will try (albeit poorly) to “rebuild” the data of correctly functioning computers. Its forte is destroying any kind of data. No matter how strong the Digimon, Datamon will easily destroy the data that comprises its body. Its special move Digital Bomb is fired from its fingertips.
description.zh: 超小型的治療用機械數碼寶貝。原本是用來修復當機的電腦，如同疫苗的數碼寶貝，但受到了強大的病毒型數碼寶貝攻擊，使得思考迴路遭到破壞而失控。就算遇上正常運作的電腦也會擅自重組數據資料（當然是重組得一團亂），使其失去控制。分子獸擅長破壞任何數據資料，無論對手是多強的數碼寶貝，構成其身體的數據資料想必都會被分子獸輕易破壞。必殺技是從指尖發射的「插入式炸彈」。

description.en: The Ultimate Digimon with the appearance of a Digi-Eggs, and the alpha and omega of all Digimon. Digitamamon is the apex of Digivolution, and supposedly Digivolves not from a normal Digimon, but by fusing with data from another dimension. Its egg-shaped exoskeleton renders all attacks meaningless. Its special move Enigma destroys the enemy’s mind, and Nightmare Syndrome is a ball of darkness. Digimon who are hit by these moves will cease all biological activity.
description.zh: 長得像是「數碼蛋」的究極數碼寶貝。數碼蛋是所有數碼寶貝的起點，也是終點。據說位居進化頂點的蛋蛋獸不是由普通的數碼寶貝進化而成，進化條件是要與其他次元的數據融合。覆蓋體表的外骨骼有著蛋一般的形狀，所有的攻擊都無法對這個外骨骼起作用。必殺技是破壞敵人精神的「謎」，還有黑暗球體「惡夢症候群」。所有數碼寶貝只要受到這些招式攻擊，生命活動就會瞬間停止。

description.en: A Mutant Digimon DNA Digivolved from Stingmon and ExVeemon. A chimera of dragon and insect, this Digimon is known as the “Terrible Bee.” Dinobeemon cannot be easily classified as Dragon or Insectoid type, but its insect characteristics shine through. Flying through the sky with its four wings, it perceives enemies with the accuracy of its compound eyes before choking the life out of them with brutal certainty. Dinobeemon demonstrates a nature that borders on completely barbaric. It uses its special move Hell Masquerade to perform a “dance of Hell,” cutting through foes with movements fast enough to leave afterimages.
description.zh: 飛蟲獸和V仔獸EX合步進化而成的突然變異型數碼寶貝。該數碼寶貝是龍和昆蟲的合成獸，擁有別名「恐懼之蜂」。難以區別該物種是屬於龍型或昆蟲型，但顯現出的昆蟲特性相當強烈。能以四片翅膀飛上天空，用頭部的複眼正確地捕捉敵人，再準確地使敵人斷氣。此外，恐蜂獸的個性十分凶暴。必殺技是一邊以迅捷的動作留下殘像，一邊將敵人碎屍萬段的地獄之舞「地獄舞踏」。

description.en: An Aquatic Beast Man Digimon wearing a wetsuit. Cheerful by nature, Divermon can always be found swimming in the Net Ocean. Underwater movement is its forte, and it uses the underwater high-speed motor on its back to engage in speedy combat. Its special move Strike Fishing stabs the enemy with its beloved harpoon, which it calls “Trent.”
description.zh: 身穿潛水裝的水棲獸人型數碼寶貝。個性開朗，經常在「網路之海」裡游來游去。擅長水中活動，戰鬥時會利用背上的水中高速移動馬達，以發揮速度的方式戰鬥。必殺技是以愛用的魚叉「洪流」刺擊敵人的「強襲魚叉」。

description.en: Duramon is an Ultimate Digimon that’s caught a glimpse of its final destination and begun to walk towards the other side. It may not know what its future holds, but whatever obstacles it might face, it’s sure to cut through them with its own blade, tempered through repeated training. When in weapon form, the hallmark greatsword on its back demonstrates incomparable power. Its special moves include Glass Slash, where it cuts through enemies with its two arm-blades, and Blinded, a beam attack that it fires from its chest. Should this beam hit its target, it deals a huge amount of damage and brands them with the number 20.
description.zh: 朝向不停奔跑後所看見的盡頭的另一個世界，開始一步步邁進的完全體數碼寶貝。雖然不知道會有什麼樣的未來等著自己，但是就算要面對寸步難行的困境，杜蘭獸也會持續鍛鍊、等到變強之後用自己的劍來開出一條活路。杜蘭獸也會用自己持續鍛鍊得以力量增強的劍來開出一條活路。必殺技是以雙手的劍斬向敵人的「草斬」。另一招必殺技是從胸口發出的光線「調和」──如果成功擊中敵人，便能對敵人造成不小的傷害並刻上20的標誌。

description.en: An unidentified Digimon that suddenly appeared in the Digital World. The self-proclaimed “King of Digimon,” Etemon’s combat strength is unimaginable. Oh, and rumors say it manipulates the mysterious Monzaemon from behind the scenes. Clad in a reinforced monkey suit that withstands any and all attacks, Etemon bounds all over the world to this very day for the sake of unending battles. It uses its special move Love Serenade to break the enemy’s heart and sap their fighting spirit, or Dark Spirits to attack with a black sphere that obliterates all it touches.
description.zh: 突然出現在數碼世界，真實身分不明的數碼寶貝。自稱「數碼寶貝之王」，其戰鬥力超乎想像。據說就是悟空獸在暗中操縱神祕的數碼寶貝「熊仔獸」。身上穿著能夠承受任何攻擊的強化猴子裝，為了永無止盡的戰鬥，悟空獸今天也在世界各地四處奔波。必殺技是能讓敵人的內心感到難過，使其戰意消失的「愛心光線」，以及能把觸碰到的一切消滅掉的黑色球狀物「黑暗死靈球」。

description.en: An extremely skilled assassin Digimon that is superlative in the Fuma school of ninja techniques. It makes a living by undertaking missions to eliminate targets. Fumamon not only makes great use of its physical prowess in close-combat, but also utilizes shuriken and other projectile weapons to remain a threat at mid and long-range, too. As Fumamon will doggedly chase down any target that flees, its prey's only hope of survival is to defeat Fumamon itself. Fumamon is able to manipulate the trajectory of Tsubakuro, the shuriken attached to its gauntlets. This helps it use Tsubakuro to damage its targets' limbs, preventing them from moving. Fumamon then finishes off its immobile opponents with its Sharihotsu move, which makes use of Shirasagi and Kurosagi, the ninja swords on its back. Fumamon can also use the scrolls on its waist to summon Undead Digimon during its Yomi-Modoshi technique.
description.zh: 將擁有傑出暗殺技術的風魔派忍術發揮到極致的數碼寶貝。以暗殺為生，接受了委託就會解決掉指定目標。不僅擅長利用卓越的體能來近距離攻擊，也能活用手裏劍等投擲道具，所以其攻擊風格在中、遠距離攻擊時也不容易露出破綻。一旦被鎖定，目標再怎麼逃跑也窮追不捨，所以要逃過一劫就只能打倒風魔獸才行。裝備在雙手護腕上的手裏劍「燕」，能依照風魔獸的意志自由操控行動方向。利用「燕」來給予對手的手腳造成傷害，並限制其行動後，再用背上的忍刀「白鷺」與「黑鷺」使出斬擊「舍利弗」來給出致命的一擊。此外，風魔獸還能使用透過掛在腰側兩邊的卷軸「黃泉召還」，這種用來召喚不死型數碼寶貝的忍術。

description.en: This Mutant Digimon is a desktop computer trash icon that has come to life. Unlike Sukamon, who formed from a mutation of data scraps, Garbagemon is the garbage can itself. Garbage Digimon were thought to be the weakest type before Garbagemon’s appearance, but now that convention has been turned on its head. Its can is like a black hole, and those sucked into it disappear from the Digital World without a trace. Its special move Poop Bazooka is a vile attack fired from a bazooka Garbagemon made from empty cans.
description.zh: 電腦版面上的垃圾桶獲得生命後進化而成的突然變異型數碼寶貝。與數據資料殘渣發生突然變異而誕生的大便獸不同，垃圾桶本身就是這個數碼寶貝。污物系數碼寶貝一直以來都被認為是最弱的，不過隨著垃圾桶獸的出現，將會顛覆這個常識。此外，此垃圾桶如同黑洞一般，被這個垃圾桶吸入之後，就會從數碼世界消失得無影無蹤。必殺技是用空罐連接而成的火箭炮所發射，最糟糕的「大便火箭炮」攻擊。

description.en: A Bird Man Digimon with large talons and wings that allow it to fly freely through the sky. Garudamon values order and justice above all, and is also known as the nature-loving Guardian of Wind and Land. Even among Bird Digimon, Garudamon has a high degree of intelligence and fighting ability, and is worshiped as a Digimon that only a chosen few can Digivolve to. Whenever the Digital World is in chaos, Garudamon is said to appear, resolving the source of the disorder and guiding things back to a more peaceful course. Garudamon is also close friends with the hero Leomon, who possesses the same spirit. Garudamon’s special move is Shadow Wing, by which it fires a blade of wind at incredible speed to slice opponents to shreds. Shadow Wing travels so quickly that the blade itself cannot be seen. Only the shadow that follows it in the shape of a black bird is visible.
description.zh: 擁有能在天空自由翱翔的翅膀，以及巨大鉤爪的鳥人型數碼寶貝。伽樓達獸注重正義與秩序也愛護自然，是大地與風的守護神。據說要在鳥型數碼寶貝之中擁有卓越的智力和戰鬥能力，只有被選上的數碼寶貝才能進化而成，因此受到崇拜。一般認為當數碼世界的秩序混亂時，伽樓達獸就會從某處現身導正混亂的根源，把世界導向和平。此外，伽樓達獸和志同道合的勇者獅子獸是唯一的摯友。必殺技是施展超高速真空刃斬裂敵人的「影翼斬」。由於影翼斬的速度太快，沒有辦法確認影翼斬的真面目，只能看得出呈現鳥型的黑影。

description.en: A Black Dragon Digimon developed at the same time as Megadramon. Gigadramon is a fully armored combat dragon that exists as a brutal computer virus. Its signature move Evil Claw pummels with twin Giga Hands. Its special move Eradication Gears unleashes infinite organic missiles.
description.zh: 與超蛇龍獸同時期開發的黑暗龍數碼寶貝。經過更進一步的改造成為完全武裝的戰鬥龍，其存在本身就等同於凶惡的電腦病毒。擅長的招式是透過雙臂的千兆手臂發動攻擊的「罪惡鋼爪」。必殺技是能夠無限釋放有機體系導彈的「種族滅絕飛彈」。

description.en: HippoGryphonmon is a Mythical Beast Digimon that resembles a chimera. It’s said to Digivolve into Gryphonmon, but beyond that, little more about it is known. HippoGryphonmon isn’t as intelligent as Gryphonmon, as it is generally more bestial and has a ferocious personality to match. Its special move is Heat Wave, where it breathes out a stream of scorching hot air.
description.zh: 外表像是合成獸的幻獸數碼寶貝。據說進化後會變成獅鳩獸，但沒有人知道詳情如何。沒有獅鳩獸那麼高超的智力，是更接近於野獸的存在，個性也很凶狠。必殺技是噴吐出超高溫熱風的「高熱波」。

description.en: An Ultimate Digimon similar in appearance to a long-legged spider. In its normal form, Infermon has its limbs and head extended, but it can also take on a cocoon form were it draws its limbs inside its body. In cocoon form, its defense increases to the point where it can repel any attack, although this limits its movement to a straight line. It can easily overcome the tightest security to infiltrate any network. Should Infermon ever be released onto the Network, the world would be plunged into chaos. Its special moves include Spider Shooter, where it fires an energy bomb of incredible destructive power from the gunport in its mouth, and Cocoon Attack, where it charges into foes in its cocoon form.
description.zh: 完全體數碼寶貝，外表像擁有細長的腿的蜘蛛。可以變成伸出頭與手腳的普通型態，以及將手腳縮進身體的繭型態。只要一進入繭型態，防禦力就會提升到足以反彈各種攻擊，但是這個型態的缺點是只能直線前進，無法調整方向。地獄使者獸能夠無視堅強的防護網，侵入各種網路。如果地獄使者獸被放進網路中，全世界想必會陷入大混亂。必殺技是從嘴裡的槍口發射破壞力驚人的能量彈的「地獄榴彈」，還有以繭型態衝向敵人的「魔繭衝擊」。

description.en: A mimic Digimon that conceals itself from foes with its potato-like appearance. Timid and with no love of combat, Jagamon nevertheless possesses an exceedingly high hidden potential for battle. This peaceful creature loves eating and sleeping above all else. Jagamon’s epidermis is several degrees harder than it looks, allowing it to endure enemy attacks if it curls up its limbs and head. The part that looks like a sprout serves the role of a radar to detect enemy movements from behind and above, keeping it aware of its surroundings even with its head hidden. It uses its special move Smashed Potatoes to fire off a part of its epidermis.
description.zh: 乍看之下像顆馬鈴薯，能夠騙過敵人眼睛隱藏自己的擬態型數碼寶貝。個性膽小，不太喜歡戰鬥，但是藏有相當強大的戰鬥能力。平常就愛吃飯睡覺，最喜歡和平。表皮比看起來硬上許多，能夠縮起手腳與頭部，抵擋對手的攻擊。看起來像是芽的部分有雷達的功能，能夠偵測來自上方或後方的敵人動態。薯仔獸即使把頭縮起來也能清楚知道四周的情況。必殺技是發射部分表皮的「馬鈴薯碎擊」。

description.en: A Digimon specializing in aerial combat that flies at the speed of sound. Jazarichmon is master dogfighter that’s shot down countless foes. It’s reckoned among the best aerial combatants in the Digital World, and is even considered to be a match for Wingdramon. Since it has legs, it can fly unhindered at the speed of sound even when passing low over the ground or when traveling through an area with many obstacles.
description.zh: 專門進行空戰，能以音速飛行的數碼寶貝。空中纏鬥對機戰鳥獸而言易如反掌，至今已擊毀了無數敵人。在數碼世界內，論空戰的話機戰鳥獸是數一數二的強，甚至不遜於鼎鼎大名的翔龍獸。由於機戰鳥獸有腳，即使貼近地表或處於有許多障礙物的區域都能夠以音速飛行，不受妨礙。

description.en: A giant Warrior Digimon donning armor of heavy Chrondigizoid. Despite the weight of its armor, Knightmon possesses the strength to wield its beloved sword with ease. One theory claims that it wears such substantial armor in order to prevent its awesome power from causing it to go berserk. Knightmon is a faithful Digimon whose existence is founded on loyal service. It adopts the attributes of its master as its own faith, laboring either in the service of justice or wickedness. It uses its special move Berserk Sword to cleave all things in two with a rampaging swing of its blade.
description.zh: 全身包裹著數碼合金製成的重量級甲冑，體型壯碩的戰士型數碼寶貝。由於力量強大，因此即使身穿盔甲，騎士獸仍能輕鬆揮舞自己愛用的大劍。還有一種說法是，騎士獸身穿盔甲是為了壓制難以掌控的強大力量。騎士獸為人重信義，生來是為了忠誠地侍奉主人。因此，騎士獸所貫徹的信念會隨著主人的性格而變，既有機會踏上正義之途，也有墜入邪惡的可能，這讓騎士獸為此煩惱不已。絕招「狂暴大劍」是如同狂戰士般揮舞大劍，能夠斬斷萬物。

description.en: A Mysterious Beast Digimon resembling a kamaitachi—a mythical spirit. The hairs covering Kyukimon’s body tear everything around it with their sharp edges, making it akin to a deadly bladed beast. It is very fast, kicking up whirlwinds as its body is cut up. It uses its special move Blade Twister to generate a tornado around the enemy and cut them with wind blades, or Sanrensei to shoot rhomboid seals from its forehead.
description.zh: 外貌有如傳說中的妖怪「鐮鼬」的妖獸型數碼寶貝。全身的毛髮都是利刃，能夠砍開周遭的所有一切，是宛如凶器的劍之野獸。速度也相當快，能在掀起塵捲風的同時撕裂對手的全身。必殺技是產生以敵人為中心的龍捲風，用真空刀刃使其四分五裂的「刀刃龍捲風」，以及從額頭擊出菱形印記的「三連星」。

description.en: A feminine Dark Angel Digimon with a noble presence. LadyDevimon’s Dark Side Power is strong, pure, and without equal. There are almost no instances of one of these Digimon being fully raised on a personal computer. Its special move Darkness Wave releases countless flying batlike creatures at the opponent to burn them to a crisp. Its other special move Poison converts the opponent’s power into dark energy, annihilating the foe from within. The stronger the opponent’s power, the more devastating this technique becomes.
description.zh: 身為高貴存在的女性型墮天使數碼寶貝。擁有屬於黑暗勢力，十分強大且高純度的力量，因此實力高強。據說幾乎沒有人能夠在個人的電子設備上長期培育淑女惡魔獸。必殺技是釋放出無數隻長得像蝙蝠的黑暗飛行物體，將對手燃燒殆盡的「黑暗波」。另一招必殺技是將對手的能量相變為黑暗能量，從內部殺害敵人的「劇毒」。對手力量越大，這一招就越有效。

description.en: Lavogaritamon is a Dragon Digimon with large wings that allow it to easily fly around despite its great bulk. Its powerful legs are strong enough to support it even when it draws itself up to its full height. Believed to dwell inside the magma chambers of active volcanoes in the Digital World, it’s been theorized that these Digimon live in close proximity to Volcdramon. Lavogaritamon’s preferred fighting style is to coat opponents in ash so it can manipulate their flash point and cause them to explode. Since any move an opponent might make once it’s been covered in ash could set off an explosion, this also fills victims with fear.
description.zh: 龍型數碼寶貝。巨翅可以讓沉重的身體輕鬆飛起，經過鍛鍊的雙腿則能夠讓熔火加里塔獸屹立不搖。據說熔火加里塔獸平時潛伏於數碼世界內活火山的熔岩層，也有人說熔火加里塔獸棲息在火山龍獸附近。戰鬥方式是散布粉塵覆蓋敵人，隨心控制閃火點進行爆破。由於敵人一動也有可能起火，因此只要被粉塵覆蓋，最後便會陷入不知道粉塵什麼時候會爆炸的恐懼之中。

description.en: A Pixie Digimon resembling the much-loved lilac flower. Though innocent and pure of heart, Lilamon’s beauty is deceptive, as Lilamon is said to have power over death and rebirth. Its leaves are poisonous, and doing battle with it sometimes proves fatal. Lilamon’s special moves include Lila Shower, which involves firing countless slender beams from its flower-like fingers, and Beauty Slap, where it repeatedly slaps a foe with both of its extensible arms. It’s said that anyone struck by this attack instantly becomes smitten with Lilamon. It also has the ability to entrance opponents with Pollen Spray, where Lilamon performs an elegant dance while releasing a cloud of sweet-smelling pollen.
description.zh: 妖精型數碼寶貝，其樣貌宛如受眾人所愛的花朵──紫丁香。個性純真無邪，儘管容貌美麗，卻也有一種說法是丁香獸掌管了重生與死亡。葉子帶有毒素，有時甚至能使敵人致死。必殺技是從有如葉子的手指前端放出無數細小光束的「丁香驟雨」，以及用伸縮自如的雙手連續使出巴掌的「美麗的一擊」。而且，據說接下這招的對象會在轉眼之間立刻迷上丁香獸。另外還有優雅地起舞，散播帶有美妙香氣的花粉，藉此迷惑對手的「節拍花粉」。

description.en: A Pixie Digimon born from beautiful flower petals. At first glance Lillymon looks like a small child, but it is in fact an Ultimate Digimon with immeasurable power. Possessed of a mercurial and tomboyish personality, it is said to open its heart to human girls of the same disposition. Lillymon can also be a crybaby, and becomes inconsolable once it starts sobbing, making this one of the harder Digimon to tame. But Lillymon will also offer a helping hand to the small and the weak. Able to fly using the four leaf-like wings on its back, a gentle breeze is said to follow in Lillymon’s wake. Its special move is Flower Cannon, by which it extends both of its arms, turns the flowers on its wrists into the mouth of a cannon, and fires an energy bomb.
description.zh: 從盛開的美麗花瓣中誕生的妖精型數碼寶貝。外表看似人類小孩，卻是力量深不可測的完全體數碼寶貝。個性隨心所欲又淘氣，據說會對氣質類似的人類少女敞開心房。此外，花仙獸還是個愛哭鬼，一旦開始哭就停不下來，想馴服花仙獸需要一番努力。但花仙獸也有對嬌小、弱小者伸出溫柔援手的一面。花仙獸能夠利用長在背上的四片葉狀翅膀在空中飛翔，據說在花仙獸飛過之後，會吹起一陣清爽的風。必殺技是將雙手伸向前，以手腕上的花瓣作為槍口擊發能源彈的「花仙炮」。

description.en: A Machine Digimon born when the CAD data of construction machinery leaked onto a server and fused with Beast Digimon configuration data. LoaderLeomon’s mane is a pneumatic drill, and it operates primarily in tunnel construction and Chrondigizoit mining. Chrondigizoit mines are often surrounded by hard layers of bedrock. In addition to its power and stamina, LoaderLeomon also boasts top-class abilities for a Machine Digimon. Many LoaderLeomon have stubborn personalities and take pride in their work, but people often assume they’re just hotheads. One mine with the best ore deposits in the world supposedly vanished as the result of a fight between LoaderLeomon. It unleashes its special move Bowling Storm by taking advantage of the high-speed rotation of its mane, and uses Loader Morning Star to crush foes with the iron ball on its tail.
description.zh: 營建機具的CAD數據經由伺服器外洩，與組成獸型數碼寶貝的數據融合所誕生的機械型數碼寶貝。鬃毛變成削岩機，主要在隧道工程或數碼合金金屬礦山進行作業。數碼合金金屬礦山周圍有堅硬的岩盤層，由此可知裝甲獅子獸的威力與持久力在機械型數碼寶貝之中是數一數二的存在。由於個性頑固又有匠人精神的裝甲獅子獸還不少，因此常有人將裝甲獅子獸與「動不動就跟人吵架」劃上等號。似乎也曾發生過裝甲獅子獸互相爭執，最後毀滅了埋藏量世界第一的礦山的事。必殺技是以超高速旋轉鬃毛使出的「鑽孔暴風」，還有用尾巴上的鐵球搥打敵人的「裝載晨星」。

description.en: MagnaAngemon is an High Angel Digimon. It has eight shining, silver wings. MagnaAngemon's mission in the Digital World is as a law enforcement officer, and it has the duty of supervising and surveying the many Angel Digimon. Furthermore, although it is the speaker for the essence of "Light" trying to preserve the order of the Digital World, and is usually in the shape of a priest, when the Digital World is shrouded by the essence of "Darkness", it changes into its Battle Mode and attacks the evil. In its Battle Mode, it consigns the opponent to oblivion with the Beam Shield on its left arm and the holy sword Excalibur equipped to its right arm. Also, although MagnaAngemon has a personality replete with gentleness and kindness when it is in Priest Mode, it takes on an austere personality when it is in Battle Mode. Its special move is Heaven's Gate, which manifest a door to subspace from which there is no return, and consigns the opponent to oblivion through it.
description.zh: 擁有八張閃亮銀翼的大天使型數碼寶貝。神聖天使獸在數碼世界的使命是法之執行官，有著監督監視多數天使型數碼寶貝的任務。此外還是保持數碼世界秩序的"光"之意識的代理人。平常是神官的樣子，當"暗"之意識覆蓋數碼世界之時，會變化為戰鬥型態討伐邪惡。戰鬥型態時用左腕的光束盾和右腕裝備的聖劍Excalibur將敵人埋葬。另外，神聖天使獸在神官型態時是溫柔的充滿慈愛的性格，但戰鬥型態時會轉變為嚴厲的性格。必殺技是讓不可能再次返回的亞空間大門出現將敵人埋葬的「天國之門」。

description.en: An Ancient Digimon proved to have existed long, long ago, thanks to a multitude of evidence. The warming of the Digital World defrosted some hyper-compressed data, causing it to appear in icy areas where the thaw had melted. Its whole body is covered in thick fur, and although it possesses tremendous, ancient power, Mammothmon is extremely susceptible to fire damage. The crest carved onto its face mask is a crystal of super-ancient wisdom, and it possesses a second sight that allows it to see long distances. Mammothmon’s large ears can even discern sounds in far-off places. Its special move Tusk Strikes stabs at the enemy with its two long tusks, and Tundra Breath blows a gust of chilly air from its long nose.
description.zh: 從種種跡象證實長毛象獸是從很久以前就存在的古代數碼寶貝。由於數碼世界的溫室效應，讓受到超壓縮的數據資料解壓縮，使得長毛象獸現身在冰封的冰雪區域。全身覆蓋著濃密體毛的長毛象獸雖具有遠古的強大力量，但也有著不擅應付極端熱度的一面。覆蓋面容的面具上刻印的徽章是超古代的智慧結晶，有著能夠看透遙遠彼端的千里眼之力，巨大的耳朵則是能聽見並區別遙遠的聲音。必殺技是用長長的兩根象牙突刺對手的「長牙強襲」，以及從長鼻子一口氣噴出寒冷氣息，將任何對手瞬間凍住的「凍原吐息」。

description.en: A Mollusk Digimon whose entire body is covered in a mucous-like veil. It is often seen coexisting with other Mollusk Digimon such as Shellmon and Sangomon. It has a very strong awareness of its own territory, defending it fervently from invaders in a desire to protect the Digimon it lives with in symbiosis.
description.zh: 全身有黏液般的罩子包裹的軟體型數碼寶貝。經常會目擊到和同樣被歸類為軟體型的貝殼獸和珊瑚獸共生。地盤意識非常強烈，對闖入地盤的外敵毫不留情，同時也有著相當程度的族群認同感，會保護有共生關係的數碼寶貝。

description.en: Megadramon is a Black Dragon Digimon said to possess the greatest and most terrible power of all the Ultimate-level Dragon Cyborg Digimon. It was artificially modified by an unknown individual who programmed it to destroy all. It is practically the living embodiment of a computer virus. Capable of breaching high-security computer networks with ease, Megadramon will then effortlessly mod or destroy the host computer. Its special moves include Eradication Attack, where it fires countless organic missiles from its arms, and Ultimate Slicer, which can cut through any substance.
description.zh: 據說是完全體的龍型生化數碼寶貝之中，威力最強又最為惡質的黑暗龍數碼寶貝。超蛇龍獸是由不明人士人為改造的數碼寶貝，被加入了目的是破壞一切的程式。超蛇龍獸的存在本身就如同電腦病毒，能夠輕鬆入侵由強力防護網守護的電腦網路，也能夠輕易地破壞、改造主機。必殺技是從雙臂發射無數的有機體系導彈的「種族滅絕攻擊」，還有能夠切開各種物質的「究極斬切」。

description.en: A Digivolution of Kabuterimon discovered in a tropical region of the Net Area. Approximately 1.5 times the size of Kabuterimon, MegaKabuterimon is quite large for an Insectoid Digimon. Though it has lost some of its ability to fly, it has dramatically increased the power of its horn, which is the species’ primary weapon. It’s also grown muscles at the bases of its forelimbs, improving its hand-to-hand combat ability. MegaKabuterimon (Blue) is renowned for its chivalrous nature, and is well-known for protecting weaker creatures. Its special move is Horn Buster, by which it stabs opponents with its giant horn.
description.zh: 在熱帶圈的網路區域中發現的比多獸的進化型種。體型大約是原有的1.5倍大，在昆蟲型之中也算相當大。雖然飛行能力有些許退化，但作為主力武器的角的強度卻獲得了飛躍性的提升。此外，其前肢的根部呈現肌肉狀，格鬥能力也更加提升。從性質上可看出除了生存本能以外，還會採取保護弱小的行動，宛如一名騎士。必殺技是以巨大的角刺穿敵人的「超大角炮」。

description.en: MegaSeadramon is a Digivolution of Seadramon. It is the form that Seadramon who’ve survived the harsh environment surrounding the Folder Continent take on in order to continue living in the Digital World, where only the strong survive. Through this Digivolution, MegaSeadramon’s body became a size larger, the shell on its head became sturdier, and a lightning-shaped blade grew out of its forehead. It’s also more intelligent than Seadramon, and will relentlessly seek out and destroy its foes like a homing torpedo. Its special move is Lightning Javelin, by which it fires a powerful bolt of lightning from the blade on its forehead. The carapace on its head contains a generator specifically to make this special move possible.
description.zh: 海龍獸種數碼寶貝原本勉強存活於資料夾大陸附近的嚴苛環境，為了在弱肉強食的數碼世界活下去而進化成這樣的型態。進化後體型大了一輪，覆蓋於頭部的外殼也變得更加堅硬，頭頂長出了閃電型的刀刃。與海龍獸種相比更加聰明，會像追蹤魚雷一樣執拗地追著敵人，不留活口。必殺技是從頭頂的刀刃釋放強力雷擊的「轟雷槍」。為了使出這招必殺技，超海龍獸頭部的外殼裝有發電裝置。

description.en: A Tactical Enhancement Mode that adds MailBirdramon’s armor to Greymon’s power, this upgraded form does not hinder the fighting strength of the close-quarters combatant that is Greymon. The Trident Arm supplements Greymon’s considerable strength with super-hot claws, dramatically improving MetalGreymon’s attack power. Its Giga Destroyer fires a high-energy homing laser at all enemies in the area. This annihilation technique gives Greymon—who specializes in one-on-one fights—an upper hand in battles against groups.
description.zh: 暴龍獸的威力與鎧甲巴多拉獸的裝甲組成的「戰術強化型態」將暴龍獸擅於近戰的戰鬥力完全保留，並且加以強化。「三叉戟腕擊」是讓原本就很強大的暴龍獸威力搭配超高溫的爪子，使攻擊力有了飛躍性成長的招式。「究極破壞炮」則是用超高能量的追蹤型雷射光束射向周圍所有敵人的屠殺式招數，將原本擅長一對一戰鬥的暴龍獸強化成可以應對能一對多的戰鬥。

description.en: Meteormon is a Digimon that for some reason has manifested meteorite data, included in Gotsumon’s ore data, on its surface. Composed of a hard substance that can only be found in space, it boasts a strong defense. Its special move is Galactic Flare, by which it blasts foes with strange energy waves from the furthest reaches of the cosmos.
description.zh: 礦石獸所擁有的礦石數據裡的隕石數據由於某些原因出現在表面後的樣子。由只存在於宇宙的堅硬物質組成，擁有強大的防禦力。必殺技是放射大宇宙神祕能量波的「宇宙閃光」。

description.en: A Digimon shrouded in mystery. Monzaemon looks like an ordinary stuffed bear, but rumor has it that someone—or something—has climbed in through the zipper on its back. It wraps up its opponent in the love overflowing from this cute body (albeit with scary eyes), and makes them feel happy. It uses its special move Hearts Attack to flings hearts at the enemy.
description.zh: 一切成謎的數碼寶貝。看起來是個普通的熊仔布偶，不過背上的拉鍊讓人懷疑裡頭其實有別的物體。熊仔獸會用可愛的身體(雖然眼睛很可怕)中散發出的愛包住敵人，讓對方有幸福的心情。必殺技是發射愛心的「愛心一擊」。

description.en: The king of Undead Digimon that was resurrected through the dark arts, obtaining mighty powers in the process. Originally a malicious computer virus that destroyed all the data it absorbed, Myotismon gained the ability to reanimate the data it destroyed as malignant viruses. Myotismon has an extremely cruel and cunning personality, and is an insidiously difficult Digimon to destroy. However, it can only make full use of its powers at night. During the day it’s said to be reduced to half strength. Myotismon’s special move is Night Raid, by which it commands a swarm of bats to ambush its foes.
description.zh: 藉由黑暗法術甦醒，獲得了強大力量的不死型數碼寶貝之王。原本是吸收電腦數據資料並進行破壞的凶惡電腦病毒，擁有能讓被破壞的資料轉化為惡質電腦病毒的能力。此數碼寶貝個性極為殘忍狡猾，非常難以驅逐。但據說吸血魔獸只能在夜晚發揮力量，白天時的力量會減半。必殺技是操縱無數隻蝙蝠展開突襲的「夜魔飛襲」。

description.en: A Digivolution of Kuwagamon, evolved into something more sinister than a Kabuterimon-type Digimon. The predominant improvement is its defense, which Kuwagamon lacks. Okuwamon’s ability to detect foes with antennae has been boosted, and its pincer attacks have augmented precision. Furthermore, it is clear that its most prominent characteristics are not only its survival instinct, but also its destructive impulse. Truly a Digivolution steeped in aggression. Its special move Double Scissor Claw is an upgraded version of Scissor Claw that is able to snip even the hardest diamond.
description.zh: 古加獸的進化型，進化後變得比比多獸系數碼寶貝更加凶猛。重點強化了古加獸原本較弱的防禦能力。在攻擊方面，則是增強了觸角的索敵能力與夾鉗的攻擊精準度。另外也有確認到，大古加獸最明顯的特徵是不僅擁有生存本能，還多了破壞衝動。可以說是更具攻擊性的進化型態。必殺技是「剪刀臂」的強化版，能夠鉗碎硬度10的鑽石的「亞米加剪刀臂」。

description.en: A Dragon Man Digimon DNA Digivolved from an ExVeemon and a Stingmon. It retains many elements of Dragon types, with the power of a dragon and the iron-wall defense of an insect’s carapace. More than just powerful, Paildramon also uses quick and agile moves to finish off opponents. It is very loyal, and will unquestioningly lay down its life for its master. Paildramon uses its signature move Sting Strike to rush the enemy with spikes extended from the shells on both arms. It uses its special move Death Parade Blaster to fire an energy wave from two biological cannons extending from its waist.
description.zh: V仔獸EX和飛蟲獸合步進化而成的龍人型數碼寶貝。由於基底是龍型，可以看見不少龍型數碼寶貝的要素。同時擁有龍的威力與昆蟲甲殼，防禦能力可說是堅若磐石。機甲龍獸不僅具備強大的威力，那敏捷的動作更是能給予敵人致命一擊。其性格極度忠誠，甚至願意為了主人而犧牲自己。擅長的招式是用雙手手背上伸出來的刺釘不停猛攻的「釘刺」。必殺技是從裝備於腰部的兩挺活體炮發射能量波的「死亡火箭炮」。

description.en: A Giant Bird Digimon resembling a parrot. Parrotmon is a strange bird from another Digital World that wandered in through a rift in spacetime. The claws on its feet are extremely powerful. Highly intelligent and well-composed, Parrotmon does not relish combat, but once angered it flies out of control. Its signature move is Sonic Destroyer, by which it flies at mach speed to generate a shockwave that it uses it to mow down its foes. Its special move Mjölnir Thunder involves creating an electrical current in the wings sprouting from its head and using them to call down lightning on its opponent.
description.zh: 外表像鸚鵡的巨鳥型數碼寶貝。鸚鵡獸是穿過了時空的縫隙，從其他數碼世界誤入這個世界的神祕怪鳥，腳爪有著強大的威力。具有高智力與冷靜的個性，不喜好戰鬥，但是只要發怒就會一發不可收拾。擅長的招式是以音速飛翔，再用飛翔時引起的衝擊波撂倒敵人的「音速毀滅者 」。必殺技是用長在頭上的羽毛產生電擊，在敵人頭上引發落雷的「妙爾尼爾轟雷」。

description.en: A reaper-like Digimon wielding a giant sickle and chain. Phantomon is a more advanced Ghost Digimon than Bakemon, and once it possesses an individual, their fate is almost certainly sealed. The eye-shaped crystal hanging from its neck functions like Mammothmon’s crest, providing it with a second sight that allows it to see over long distances. It uses this ability to find those near death. It is said that the inside of the cloth concealing Phantomon’s body is connected to the Digital World of another dimension. Its special move is Soul Chopper, where it uses its giant sickle and chain to slash its opponent’s very soul. Anyone struck by this attack is completely obliterated along with their soul.
description.zh: 拿著巨大的鎖鐮，有如死神的數碼寶貝。和猛鬼獸不同，是高階的幽靈數碼寶貝，要是被死神獸纏上，最後想必會迎來徹底的死亡。從脖子上垂下的眼球狀水晶和長毛象獸的徽章一樣擁有千里眼的力量，能夠看透一切，死神獸因此能看出死期將近的對象。據說覆蓋其身軀的布塊內部與其他次元的數碼世界相連。必殺技是以巨大的鎖鐮將敵人連同靈魂一起砍開的「靈魂收割」。接下這招的對象連靈魂都會一起消滅。

description.en: A Pixie Digimon that controls magic. Piximon can recite words in an advanced programming language from another dimension, allowing it to create wonders akin to magic. This mysterious Digimon can appear anytime, anyplace, and in any space. While small, it possesses a special skill that allows it to seal off the abilities of its foes, and it pulverizes opponents with a single, powerful strike. Piximon loves a good prank, and enjoys making computers run amok with the beloved spear “Fairy Tale” it always holds (not that it bears any ill will). Its special move Pit Bomb compresses a computer virus, generating a super-powered explosion. Piximon uses terrifying attacks, despite its appearance.
description.zh: 會使用魔法的妖精數碼寶貝。能夠吟唱其他次元的高階程式語言，帶來魔法般的奇蹟。這種神奇的數碼寶貝可以出現於任何地點、時間、空間，雖然體型嬌小卻能以特殊的能力封印敵人的能力，用強力的一擊粉碎對手。妖精獸相當喜歡惡作劇，平時的樂趣是用手上的愛槍「精靈尾」讓電腦失控(妖精獸自己並無惡意)。必殺技是濃縮了電腦病毒的超強力炸彈「位元炸彈」。妖精獸長得可愛，卻會使出可怕的攻擊。
